AI.title_translation: 极端边缘并行计算的时空分析
AI.tldr: 提出首个面向大规模毫米波网络EEC的时空数学模型，结合随机几何与吸收连续时间马尔可夫链刻画通信-计算并行重叠，分析平均响应时延与任务完成概率，并发现存在最优任务分割；在设备不足时通过与MEC的偏置协作降低拥塞与时延。
AI.motivation: EEC利用极端边缘设备的闲置资源以实现更低时延的分布式处理，但面临设备空间分布随机、算力受限导致需并行执行、易故障以及无线通信与执行时间的时间随机性等挑战，亟需严格的分析框架评估性能。
AI.method: 构建面向大规模毫米波网络的EEC时空数学模型：用随机几何刻画空间随机性与网络连接特性；用吸收连续时间马尔可夫链（ACTMC）刻画通信与计算的动态过程及其在并行执行中的时间重叠；分析随机化与位置感知两类卸载策略，并在模型中纳入EED故障；在EED不足场景下提出基于偏置的EEC-MEC协作卸载机制。
AI.result: （1）存在使平均任务响应时延最小的最优任务分割/分段规模；（2）在EED可用性受限时，引入偏置的EEC与MEC协作可将超额需求卸载至MEC，从而降低拥塞并提升系统响应性；（3）给出了平均任务响应时延与任务完成概率两项指标的评估结果（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了首个用于大规模毫米波EEC的时空解析框架，能够统一评估并行卸载下通信与计算交互对时延与可靠性的影响；通过选择合适的任务分割并在资源紧张时与MEC协作，可有效改善EEC系统性能。
AI.translation: 极端边缘计算（EEC）将计算推向比传统多接入边缘计算（MEC）更靠近终端用户的位置，利用极端边缘设备（EED）的空闲资源实现低时延的分布式处理。然而，EEC面临关键挑战：设备分布的空间随机性、EED算力有限而必须并行执行任务、对故障的脆弱性，以及由于无线通信与执行时间变化导致的时间随机性。这些挑战表明需要一个严格的分析框架来评估EEC性能。本文提出了首个面向大规模毫米波网络的EEC时空数学模型。该框架结合随机几何与吸收连续时间马尔可夫链（ACTMC），刻画通信与计算性能之间的复杂交互关系，包括并行执行期间二者在时间上的重叠。我们评估两个关键指标：平均任务响应时延与任务完成概率，从而全面反映时延与可靠性。分析考虑了随机化与位置感知等基础卸载策略，并将EED故障纳入考量。结果表明存在最优任务分割可使时延最小。在EED可用性有限时，我们研究了一种基于偏置的EEC与MEC协作机制，将超额需求卸载到MEC资源上，从而有效降低拥塞并提升系统响应性。
AI.summary: 论文针对极端边缘计算在毫米波大规模网络中的性能评估难题，提出结合随机几何与吸收连续时间马尔可夫链的时空分析模型，显式建模并行卸载时通信与计算的耦合与时间重叠，并在考虑设备故障的前提下，对随机化与位置感知卸载策略下的平均响应时延和任务完成概率进行解析评估。核心发现包括：任务分割存在可最小化时延的最优点；当极端边缘设备不足时，通过偏置控制的EEC-MEC协作将部分负载转移至MEC可缓解拥塞、提升响应性与整体性能。
AI.keywords: 极端边缘计算(EEC), 多接入边缘计算(MEC), 毫米波网络, 随机几何, 吸收连续时间马尔可夫链(ACTMC), 并行计算, 任务分割, 卸载策略, 时空建模, 任务响应时延, 任务完成概率, 设备故障, EEC-MEC协作, 偏置卸载
AI.comments: 贡献点突出在于将空间随机网络模型与时间演化的计算/通信过程统一到可解析框架中，并显式处理并行执行的时间重叠与故障影响；摘要未说明具体网络/队列/计算模型细节、参数设定、推导形式与数值结果规模，也未给出最优分割的闭式表达或求解方法。

title: On the approximation of the von Neumann equation in the semiclassical limit. Part II : numerical analysis
summary: This paper is devoted to the numerical analysis of the Hermite spectral method proposed in [14], which provides, in the semiclassical limit, an asymptotic preserving approximation of the von Neumann equation. More precisely, it relies on the use of so-called Weyl's variables to effectively address the stiffness associated to the equation. Then by employing a truncated Hermite expansion of the density operator, we successfully manage this stiffness and provide error estimates by leveraging the propagation of regularity in the exact solution.

AI.title_translation: 半经典极限下冯·诺依曼方程的近似（第二部分：数值分析）
AI.tldr: 对一种基于Hermite谱方法、使用Weyl变量并具备渐近保持（AP）性质的冯·诺依曼方程半经典极限近似进行数值分析，通过截断Hermite展开处理刚性并给出误差估计。
AI.motivation: 在半经典极限下冯·诺依曼方程存在刚性（stiffness）导致数值求解困难，需要一种能有效处理刚性且在极限下仍保持正确行为的数值方法并对其进行严格分析。
AI.method: 对文献[14]提出的Hermite谱方法做数值误差分析：使用Weyl变量缓解方程刚性；将密度算子做截断的Hermite级数展开；利用精确解的正则性传播（propagation of regularity）推导误差估计。
AI.result: 通过截断Hermite展开“成功管理”由方程引起的刚性，并基于精确解的正则性传播给出了误差估计。
AI.conclusion: 该Hermite谱方法在半经典极限下为冯·诺依曼方程提供渐近保持的近似；采用Weyl变量与截断Hermite展开可有效应对刚性，并能建立相应误差界。
AI.translation: 本文致力于对文献[14]中提出的Hermite谱方法进行数值分析。该方法在半经典极限下为冯·诺依曼方程提供一种渐近保持的近似。更具体地，它依赖于使用所谓的Weyl变量来有效处理该方程相关的刚性。随后，通过对密度算子采用截断的Hermite展开，我们成功地控制了这种刚性，并借助精确解正则性的传播给出了误差估计。
AI.summary: 论文（第二部分）围绕半经典极限下冯·诺依曼方程的数值求解展开，重点分析已有的Hermite谱离散方案。核心思想是引入Weyl变量以弱化/规避半经典尺度带来的刚性，再用密度算子的截断Hermite展开实现可计算的谱近似。在理论层面，作者利用精确解的正则性传播性质建立该截断谱近似的误差估计，从而论证方法的稳定有效与渐近保持特性。
AI.keywords: 冯·诺依曼方程; 半经典极限; 渐近保持(AP); Hermite谱方法; Weyl变量; 刚性(stiffness); 密度算子; 截断Hermite展开; 误差估计; 正则性传播
AI.comments: 摘要未提及：具体误差阶/收敛率、时间/空间离散细节、算法实现与复杂度、数值实验设置与结果、适用的势函数/边界条件假设、与其他方法的对比。

title: Deterministic Distributed DFS and Other Problems via Cycle Separators in Planar Graphs
summary:
One of the most basic techniques in algorithm design consists of breaking a problem into subproblems and then proceeding recursively. In the case of graph algorithms, one way to implement this approach is through separator sets. Given a graph $G=(V,E)$, a subset of nodes $S \subseteq V$ is called a separator set of $G$ if the size of each connected component of $G-S$ is at most $2/3 \cdot |V|$. The most useful separator sets are those that satisfy certain restrictions of cardinality or structure. For over 40 years, various efficient algorithms have been developed for computing separators of different kinds, particularly in planar graphs. Separator sets, combined with a divide and conquer approach, have been fundamental in the design of efficient algorithms in various settings.
  In this work, we present the first deterministic algorithm in the distributed CONGEST model that recursively computes a cycle separator in planar graphs in $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(D)$ rounds. This result, as in the centralized setting, has significant implications for distributed planar algorithms. In fact, from this result, we can construct a deterministic algorithm that computes a DFS tree in $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(D)$ rounds. This matches both the best-known randomized algorithm of Ghaffari and Parter (DISC'17) and, up to polylogarithmic factors, the trivial lower bound of $Ω(D)$ rounds.
  Besides DFS, our deterministic cycle separator algorithm can be used to derandomize several planar-graph algorithms whose only randomized ingredient is the computation of a cycle separator, such as maximum flow (Abd-Elhaleem, Dory, Parter and Weimann, PODC'25), single-source shortest path (Li and Parter, STOC'19), and reachability (Parter, DISC'20).

AI.title_translation: 通过平面图中的环分隔器实现确定性分布式DFS及其他问题
AI.tldr: 提出首个在分布式CONGEST模型下、以\tilde{O}(D)轮递归计算平面图环分隔器的确定性算法，并由此给出\tilde{O}(D)轮的确定性DFS算法，同时可去随机化多种依赖环分隔器的平面图分布式算法。
AI.motivation: 分隔器+分治是图算法的基础工具；平面图分隔器计算已有大量集中式成果，但在分布式CONGEST中缺乏同等高效的确定性环分隔器与由此带来的确定性基础算法（如DFS）及去随机化能力。
AI.method: 在分布式CONGEST模型中递归计算平面图的环分隔器（cycle separator），并以该分隔器作为关键子程序构造确定性的分布式DFS树算法；同时将该确定性环分隔器用于替换若干既有随机化平面图算法中唯一的随机环分隔器步骤以实现去随机化。
AI.result: 1) 首个确定性分布式环分隔器算法：\tilde{O}(D)轮递归计算平面图cycle separator。2) 构造确定性DFS：\tilde{O}(D)轮得到DFS树，匹配Ghaffari与Parter(2017)的最佳随机算法，并在polylog因子内接近Ω(D)下界。3) 可用于去随机化最大流、单源最短路、可达性等算法中依赖环分隔器的随机部分。
AI.conclusion: 确定性地在\tilde{O}(D)轮内计算平面图环分隔器在分布式环境中成为可能，并可作为通用构件推动多类平面图分布式算法达到接近最优的确定性轮复杂度并实现去随机化。
AI.translation: 基本算法设计技术之一是将问题拆分为子问题并递归求解。在图算法中，可通过分隔器集合实现：对图G=(V,E)，若删去节点子集S后得到的每个连通分量大小至多为(2/3)|V|，则称S为分隔器。最有用的分隔器还需满足规模或结构限制。四十多年来，人们发展了多种高效分隔器算法，尤其在平面图中；分隔器结合分治在多种环境下的高效算法设计中至关重要。本工作提出首个在分布式CONGEST模型下、以\tilde{O}(D)轮递归计算平面图环分隔器的确定性算法，并像集中式情形一样对分布式平面图算法有重要影响。由此可构造在\tilde{O}(D)轮内计算DFS树的确定性算法，既匹配Ghaffari与Parter(DISC’17)的最佳随机算法，也在polylog因子内达到平凡下界Ω(D)。此外，该确定性环分隔器算法还能用于去随机化若干平面图算法中唯一的随机成分——环分隔器计算，例如最大流(PODC’25)、单源最短路(STOC’19)与可达性(DISC’20)。
AI.summary: 论文围绕“分隔器驱动的分治”在分布式平面图算法中的作用，提出了在CONGEST模型下以\tilde{O}(D)轮递归求解平面图环分隔器的首个确定性算法。借助该环分隔器作为核心工具，作者进一步给出\tilde{O}(D)轮的确定性DFS构造，性能与已知最佳随机结果相当，并在多对数因子内接近Ω(D)的下界。除DFS外，该环分隔器还可作为通用去随机化模块，替换一系列平面图分布式算法（最大流、单源最短路、可达性）中唯一依赖随机性的环分隔器步骤，从而将这些算法推进到确定性框架中。
AI.keywords: 分布式算法, CONGEST模型, 平面图, 环分隔器, 图分隔器, 确定性算法, DFS, 去随机化, 轮复杂度, 直径D
AI.comments: 仅基于摘要可知：算法轮复杂度为\tilde{O}(D)，并强调“递归计算环分隔器”；但未给出环分隔器的具体构造细节、实现机制、隐藏的polylog因子来源、消息复杂度/本地计算复杂度、适用的平面图输入表示假设（如嵌入是否给定）以及对最大流/SSSP/可达性去随机化后的最终复杂度与完整算法描述。

title: Whleaper: A 10-DOF Flexible Bipedal Wheeled Robot
summary: Wheel-legged robots combine the advantages of both wheeled robots and legged robots, offering versatile locomotion capabilities with excellent stability on challenging terrains and high efficiency on flat surfaces. However, existing wheel-legged robots typically have limited hip joint mobility compared to humans, while hip joint plays a crucial role in locomotion. In this paper, we introduce Whleaper, a novel 10-degree-of-freedom (DOF) bipedal wheeled robot, with 3 DOFs at the hip of each leg. Its humanoid joint design enables adaptable motion in complex scenarios, ensuring stability and flexibility. This paper introduces the details of Whleaper, with a focus on innovative mechanical design, control algorithms and system implementation. Firstly, stability stems from the increased DOFs at the hip, which expand the range of possible postures and improve the robot's foot-ground contact. Secondly, the extra DOFs also augment its mobility. During walking or sliding, more complex movements can be adopted to execute obstacle avoidance tasks. Thirdly, we utilize two control algorithms to implement multimodal motion for walking and sliding. By controlling specific DOFs of the robot, we conducted a series of simulations and practical experiments, demonstrating that a high-DOF hip joint design can effectively enhance the stability and flexibility of wheel-legged robots. Whleaper shows its capability to perform actions such as squatting, obstacle avoidance sliding, and rapid turning in real-world scenarios.

AI.title_translation: Whleaper：一种10自由度的柔性双足轮式机器人
AI.tldr: 提出一款每条腿髋部具备3自由度的10-DOF双足轮式机器人Whleaper，并通过控制算法、仿真与实机实验验证高自由度髋关节可提升轮足机器人的稳定性与灵活性，展示下蹲、避障滑行与快速转向等能力。
AI.motivation: 现有轮足机器人相较人类通常髋关节活动度有限，而髋关节对运动能力至关重要；因此需要通过提升髋部自由度来增强复杂场景下的稳定性与机动性。
AI.method: 设计并实现Whleaper：10自由度双足轮式机器人（每条腿髋部3自由度的类人关节设计）；提出并使用两种控制算法实现步行与滑行的多模态运动；通过控制特定自由度开展仿真与实际实验验证，并给出机械设计、控制与系统实现细节。
AI.result: 仿真与实机实验表明：高自由度髋关节设计可有效提升轮足机器人的稳定性与灵活性；Whleaper在真实场景中实现了下蹲、避障滑行与快速转向等动作，并在步行/滑行时可采用更复杂动作完成避障任务。
AI.conclusion: 增加髋关节自由度能够扩大可实现姿态范围、改善足地接触，从而提升稳定性；同时增强机动性并支持步行与滑行等多模态运动，使轮足机器人在复杂场景中更灵活可控。
AI.translation: 轮足机器人结合了轮式机器人与足式机器人的优势，既能在崎岖地形上保持良好稳定性，又能在平坦地面上实现高效率运动。然而，现有轮足机器人通常髋关节活动度较人类受限，而髋关节在运动中起关键作用。本文提出Whleaper，一种新型10自由度双足轮式机器人，每条腿髋部具备3自由度。其类人关节设计使机器人在复杂场景中具备更强的适应性，兼顾稳定与灵活。本文介绍Whleaper的细节，重点包括创新机械设计、控制算法与系统实现。首先，稳定性来源于髋部自由度增加带来的更大可行姿态范围与更优的足地接触。其次，额外自由度也提升了机动性，在行走或滑行过程中可采用更复杂动作执行避障任务。第三，本文采用两种控制算法实现步行与滑行的多模态运动。通过控制机器人特定自由度，我们进行了多组仿真与实机实验，证明高自由度髋关节设计能有效提升轮足机器人的稳定性与灵活性。Whleaper在真实场景中展示了下蹲、避障滑行与快速转向等能力。
AI.summary: 论文面向轮足机器人髋部活动度不足的问题，提出10自由度双足轮式机器人Whleaper，通过每腿3自由度髋关节的类人结构扩展姿态与足地接触条件，并配合两种控制算法实现步行/滑行多模态运动。通过仿真与实机实验验证该高自由度髋部设计能显著提升稳定性与灵活性，展示了下蹲、避障滑行和快速转向等实用动作能力。
AI.keywords: 轮足机器人; 双足轮式机器人; 10自由度; 髋关节多自由度; 类人关节设计; 稳定性; 机动性; 多模态运动控制; 步行; 滑行; 避障
AI.comments: 创新点在于将每腿髋部提升至3自由度并系统性论证其对稳定性与灵活性的增益；但摘要未给出两种控制算法的具体形式、定量指标（如速度、能耗、稳定裕度）、实验对比基线与统计结果。

title: Matrix Factorizations with Uniformly Random Pivoting
summary:
This paper highlights a formal connection between two families of widely used matrix factorization algorithms in numerical linear algebra. One family consists of the Jacobi eigenvalue algorithm and its variants for computing the Hermitian eigendecomposition and singular value decomposition. The other consists of Gaussian elimination and the Gram-Schmidt procedure with various pivoting rules for computing the Cholesky decomposition and QR decomposition respectively.
  Both families are cast as special cases of a more general class of factorization algorithms. We provide a randomized pivoting rule that applies to this general class (which differs substantially from the usual pivoting rules for Gaussian elimination / Gram-Schmidt) which admits a unified analysis of the entire class of algorithms. The result is the same linear rate of convergence for each algorithm, irrespective of which factorization it computes.
  One important consequence of this randomized pivoting rule is a provable polynomial bound on the numerical stability of the Jacobi eigenvalue algorithm without any preconditioning, which addresses a longstanding open problem of Demmel and Veselić `92.

AI.title_translation: 具有均匀随机主元选择的矩阵分解
AI.tldr: 将Jacobi类特征值/SVD算法与带主元的高斯消元/Gram-Schmidt（Cholesky/QR）统一到同一一般分解框架中，并提出一种“均匀随机主元”规则，实现对整类算法的统一收敛分析（相同线性收敛率），并给出无需预条件的Jacobi算法数值稳定性多项式界，从而解决Demmel与Veselić(1992)提出的长期开放问题。
AI.motivation: 揭示并利用Jacobi类算法与消元/正交化类算法之间的形式联系，以获得跨不同分解任务的统一理论保证；同时解决Jacobi特征值算法在无预条件下数值稳定性缺乏可证明界的长期开放问题。
AI.method: 将Jacobi特征值/奇异值算法以及带不同主元规则的高斯消元与Gram-Schmidt统一表述为更一般的一类分解算法；在该一般类上提出一种不同于传统消元/Gram-Schmidt主元策略的“均匀随机主元选择”随机化枢轴规则，并据此进行整类算法的统一收敛与稳定性分析。
AI.result: 在所提出的随机主元规则下，该一般类中的每一种算法（无论计算Hermitian特征分解、SVD、Cholesky还是QR）都获得相同的线性收敛率；并且对Jacobi特征值算法（无预条件）给出了可证明的数值稳定性多项式上界。
AI.conclusion: 均匀随机主元规则为多种经典矩阵分解算法提供了统一的分析框架与一致的线性收敛保证，并进一步在无需预条件的情况下为Jacobi特征值算法建立多项式稳定性界，从而解决Demmel与Veselić(1992)的开放问题。
AI.translation: 本文强调数值线性代数中两大类常用矩阵分解算法之间的形式联系：一类为Jacobi特征值算法及其变体，用于计算Hermitian特征分解与奇异值分解；另一类为带各种主元规则的高斯消元与Gram-Schmidt过程，分别用于计算Cholesky分解与QR分解。两类算法都可视为更一般分解算法类的特例。我们为该一般类提出一种随机主元选择规则（与高斯消元/Gram-Schmidt的常见主元策略显著不同），从而能够对整类算法进行统一分析。由此得到的结论是：无论算法计算何种分解，它们都具有相同的线性收敛速率。该随机主元规则的一个重要后果是：在无需任何预条件的情况下，为Jacobi特征值算法的数值稳定性给出可证明的多项式界，解决了Demmel与Veselić(1992)提出的一个长期开放问题。
AI.summary: 论文把Jacobi类（特征分解/SVD）与消元/正交化类（Cholesky/QR）算法纳入同一“广义分解算法”框架，并引入一种统一适用的均匀随机主元策略。该策略使得可以对整类算法进行统一的收敛证明，得到与具体分解目标无关的相同线性收敛率；同时还导出Jacobi特征值算法在不做预条件时的数值稳定性多项式上界，进而解决1992年提出的开放稳定性问题。
AI.keywords: 矩阵分解; 随机主元选择; 均匀随机枢轴; Jacobi特征值算法; 奇异值分解(SVD); 高斯消元; Gram-Schmidt; Cholesky分解; QR分解; 线性收敛; 数值稳定性; 统一分析
AI.comments: 创新点在于用“均匀随机主元”把看似不同的分解算法统一到同一分析管线，并给出跨算法一致的线性收敛率；影响较大之处是对无预条件Jacobi算法稳定性给出多项式界，直接回应并解决Demmel与Veselić(1992)的公开问题。抽象未提及具体算法细节、复杂度常数、适用矩阵条件或实验验证。

title: Fast Bellman algorithm for real Monge-Ampere equation
summary:
In this paper, we introduce a new numerical algorithm for solving the Dirichlet problem for the real Monge--Ampere equation. The idea is to represent the non-linear Monge--Ampere operator as an infimum of a class of linear elliptic operators and use Bellman's principle to construct a numeric scheme for approximating the operator attaining this infimum.
  Moreover, we prove convergence of the proposed algorithm (under suitable technical assumptions) and discuss its strengths and weaknesses. We also demonstrate the performance of the method on several examples with various degrees of regularity and degeneracy and compare the results to two existing methods. Our method runs considerably faster than the ones used for comparison, improving the running time by a factor of 3--10 for smooth, strictly convex examples, and by a factor of 20--100 or more for mildly degenerate examples.

AI.title_translation: 用于实 Monge–Ampère 方程的快速 Bellman 算法
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于将 Monge–Ampère 算子表示为线性椭圆算子族下确界并用 Bellman 原理构造的数值算法，用于求解实 Monge–Ampère 方程的 Dirichlet 问题；在技术假设下证明收敛，并在多种算例上显示相较两种现有方法显著提速。
AI.motivation: 为实 Monge–Ampère 方程 Dirichlet 问题设计更高效的数值求解算法，并在不同正则性/退化程度下兼顾可用性与性能，且优于现有方法的运行时间。
AI.method: 将非线性 Monge–Ampère 算子表示为一类线性椭圆算子取下确界（infimum）的形式；利用 Bellman 原理构造数值格式来逼近实现该下确界的算子；并在若干技术条件下给出收敛性证明；通过多个具有不同正则性与退化性的例子进行实验，并与两种现有方法对比。
AI.result: 算法在实验中显著加速：对光滑且严格凸的例子，运行时间提升约 3–10 倍；对轻度退化的例子，提升约 20–100 倍或更高；并给出在适当技术假设下的收敛性证明；同时讨论了方法的优缺点。
AI.conclusion: 该快速 Bellman 数值算法可用于实 Monge–Ampère 方程 Dirichlet 问题的有效求解，在理论上（技术假设下）收敛，并在多类问题上较对比方法展现出大幅度的计算效率优势。
AI.translation: 本文提出一种用于求解实 Monge–Ampère 方程 Dirichlet 问题的新数值算法。核心思想是将非线性的 Monge–Ampère 算子表示为一类线性椭圆算子在下确界意义下的形式，并利用 Bellman 原理构造数值格式以逼近实现该下确界的算子。进一步地，我们在适当的技术假设下证明了所提算法的收敛性，并讨论其优点与不足。我们还在若干具有不同正则性与退化程度的例子上展示该方法的性能，并与两种现有方法进行比较。结果表明：对光滑、严格凸的例子，本文方法运行速度快约 3–10 倍；对轻度退化的例子，快约 20–100 倍或更多。
AI.summary: 论文面向实 Monge–Ampère 方程的 Dirichlet 边值问题，提出基于 Bellman 原理的快速数值算法：通过把 Monge–Ampère 非线性算子重写为线性椭圆算子族的下确界，再构造相应离散格式来逼近达到下确界的算子。作者在技术条件下证明算法收敛，并通过不同正则性/退化性的算例评测，与两种已有方法相比在光滑严格凸情形提速 3–10 倍、在轻度退化情形提速 20–100 倍以上，同时讨论了方法的优势与局限。
AI.keywords: 实 Monge–Ampère 方程; Dirichlet 问题; Bellman 原理; Bellman 算法; 数值算法; 非线性 PDE; 线性椭圆算子; 下确界表示; 收敛性; 退化与正则性; 性能对比

title: Image Segmentation via Variational Model Based Tailored UNet: A Deep Variational Framework
summary: Traditional image segmentation methods, such as variational models based on partial differential equations (PDEs), offer strong mathematical interpretability and precise boundary modeling, but often suffer from sensitivity to parameter settings and high computational costs. In contrast, deep learning models such as UNet, which are relatively lightweight in parameters, excel in automatic feature extraction but lack theoretical interpretability and require extensive labeled data. To harness the complementary strengths of both paradigms, we propose Variational Model Based Tailored UNet (VM_TUNet), a novel hybrid framework that integrates the fourth-order modified Cahn-Hilliard equation with the deep learning backbone of UNet, which combines the interpretability and edge-preserving properties of variational methods with the adaptive feature learning of neural networks. Specifically, a data-driven operator is introduced to replace manual parameter tuning, and we incorporate the tailored finite point method (TFPM) to enforce high-precision boundary preservation. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that VM_TUNet achieves superior segmentation performance compared to existing approaches, especially for fine boundary delineation.

AI.title_translation: 基于变分模型的定制化UNet图像分割：一种深度变分框架
AI.tldr: 提出VM_TUNet，将四阶改进Cahn–Hilliard变分方程与UNet融合，并用数据驱动算子替代人工调参、引入TFPM以增强边界精度，在基准数据集上取得优于现有方法的分割效果，尤其在精细边界上更突出。
AI.motivation: 传统PDE变分分割方法可解释性强、边界建模精确但对参数敏感且计算开销大；UNet等深度模型特征提取强且参数相对轻量，但缺乏理论可解释性并依赖大量标注数据。为结合两者优势而提出混合框架。

AI.result: 在基准数据集实验中，VM_TUNet相较现有方法取得更优的分割性能，尤其在细粒度边界勾勒方面表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 将可解释的变分PDE模型与UNet的自适应特征学习结合，并通过数据驱动算子与TFPM增强边界精度，可提升图像分割整体性能与边界质量。

title: Efficient Graph Embedding at Scale: Optimizing CPU-GPU-SSD Integration
summary: Graph embeddings map graph nodes to continuous vectors and are foundational to community detection, recommendation, and many scientific applications. At billion-scale, however, existing graph embedding systems face a trade-off: they either rely on large in-memory footprints across many GPUs (limited scalability) or repeatedly stream data from disk (incurring severe I/O overhead and low GPU utilization). In this paper, we propose Legend, a lightweight heterogeneous system for graph embedding that systematically redesigns data management across CPU, GPU, and NVMe SSD resources. Legend combines three practical ideas: (1) a prefetch-friendly embedding-loading order that lets GPUs efficiently prefetch necessary embeddings directly from NVMe SSD with low I/O amplification; (2) a high-throughput GPU-SSD direct-access driver tuned for the access patterns of embedding training; and (3) a customized parallel execution strategy that maximizes GPU utilization. Together, these components let Legend store and stream vast embedding data without overprovisioning GPU memory or suffering I/O stalls. Extensive experiments on billion-scale graphs demonstrate that Legend speeds up end-to-end workloads by up to 4.8x versus state-of-the-art systems, and matches their performance on the largest workloads while using only one quarter of the GPUs.

AI.title_translation: 面向大规模的高效图嵌入：优化CPU-GPU-SSD一体化
AI.tldr: 提出轻量异构系统Legend，通过重构CPU/GPU/NVMe SSD间的数据管理与执行策略，在十亿级图嵌入训练中降低I/O开销并提升GPU利用率，端到端最高加速4.8倍，且在最大工作负载上用1/4的GPU达到同等性能。
AI.motivation: 十亿级图嵌入现有系统面临权衡：要么依赖多GPU的大内存驻留导致可扩展性受限，要么频繁从磁盘流式读取引发严重I/O开销与低GPU利用率。
AI.method: 提出Legend异构系统，系统性重设计CPU、GPU与NVMe SSD之间的数据管理与训练执行：1) 预取友好的embedding加载顺序，使GPU可从NVMe SSD直接高效预取且I/O放大低；2) 面向嵌入训练访问模式调优的高吞吐GPU-SSD直达访问驱动；3) 定制化并行执行策略以最大化GPU利用率。
AI.result: 在十亿规模图上的大量实验表明：Legend端到端工作负载相对SOTA最高提升4.8倍；在最大工作负载上性能与SOTA相当，但仅使用其1/4的GPU。
AI.conclusion: 通过CPU-GPU-SSD协同的数据管理、GPU直连SSD访问与并行执行优化，Legend能够在不超配GPU内存的情况下存储并流式处理海量嵌入数据，避免I/O停顿并显著提升整体效率与资源利用率。
AI.translation: 图嵌入将图节点映射为连续向量，是社区检测、推荐及多种科学应用的基础。但在十亿规模下，现有图嵌入系统面临取舍：要么在多块GPU上依赖巨大的内存占用（限制可扩展性），要么反复从磁盘流式读取数据（造成严重I/O开销和低GPU利用率）。本文提出Legend，一个用于图嵌入的轻量异构系统，系统性重设计CPU、GPU与NVMe SSD资源之间的数据管理。Legend结合三点实用思路：(1) 预取友好的嵌入加载顺序，使GPU能够以较低I/O放大从NVMe SSD直接高效预取所需嵌入；(2) 针对嵌入训练访问模式调优的高吞吐GPU-SSD直达访问驱动；(3) 最大化GPU利用率的定制并行执行策略。这些组件共同使Legend能够在不超配GPU内存且不遭遇I/O阻塞的情况下存储并流式处理海量嵌入数据。在十亿规模图上的广泛实验表明，Legend相对最先进系统端到端最高加速可达4.8倍，并且在最大工作负载上仅用四分之一的GPU即可达到相同性能。
AI.summary: 论文面向十亿级图嵌入训练的系统瓶颈，提出Legend，通过调整embedding加载顺序以利于GPU从NVMe SSD预取、提供针对训练模式优化的GPU-SSD直达驱动、以及定制并行执行来提升GPU利用率，从而在不依赖大规模GPU显存驻留的情况下减少I/O停顿并提升端到端性能；实验显示最高4.8倍加速，并能以更少GPU达到同等最大规模性能。

title: Tuning-Free LLM Can Build A Strong Recommender Under Sparse Connectivity And Knowledge Gap Via Extracting Intent
summary: Recent advances in recommendation with large language models (LLMs) often rely on either commonsense augmentation at the item-category level or implicit intent modeling on existing knowledge graphs. However, such approaches struggle to capture grounded user intents and to handle sparsity and cold-start scenarios. In this work, we present LLM-based Intent Knowledge Graph Recommender (IKGR), a novel framework that constructs an intent-centric knowledge graph where both users and items are explicitly linked to intent nodes extracted by a tuning-free, RAG-guided LLM pipeline. By grounding intents in external knowledge sources and user profiles, IKGR canonically represents what a user seeks and what an item satisfies as first-class entities. To alleviate sparsity, we further introduce a mutual-intent connectivity densification strategy, which shortens semantic paths between users and long-tail items without requiring cross-graph fusion. Finally, a lightweight GNN layer is employed on top of the intent-enhanced graph to produce recommendation signals with low latency. Extensive experiments on public and enterprise datasets demonstrate that IKGR consistently outperforms strong baselines, particularly on cold-start and long-tail slices, while remaining efficient through a fully offline LLM pipeline.

AI.title_translation: 无需调参的LLM：通过意图抽取在稀疏连接与知识鸿沟下构建强推荐器
AI.tldr: 提出IKGR：用无需微调、RAG引导的LLM离线抽取并落地用户/物品“意图”节点构建意图中心知识图谱，再用互意图连通性增密与轻量GNN生成推荐信号，在冷启动与长尾场景显著优于强基线且高效低延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐多依赖物品-类别层面的常识增强或在既有知识图上做隐式意图建模，难以捕获“有依据的”用户意图，并且在图连接稀疏、知识缺口以及冷启动/长尾场景表现受限。
AI.method: IKGR框架：1) 通过无需调参的、RAG引导的LLM流水线从外部知识源与用户画像中抽取意图，构建意图中心知识图谱，将用户与物品显式连接到意图节点；2) 提出“互意图连通性增密”策略，在不做跨图融合的情况下缩短用户与长尾物品间的语义路径以缓解稀疏；3) 在意图增强图上叠加轻量GNN层生成推荐信号以降低时延；4) LLM流程为全离线以保证效率。
AI.result: 在公开与企业数据集上的大量实验表明，IKGR持续优于强基线，尤其在冷启动与长尾切片上提升更明显；同时由于LLM全离线与轻量GNN推理，整体保持高效与低延迟。
AI.conclusion: 显式、可落地的意图节点（由无需调参且RAG引导的LLM抽取）结合连通性增密与轻量GNN，可在连接稀疏与知识鸿沟条件下构建更强且高效的推荐系统，特别改善冷启动与长尾推荐。
AI.translation: 译文（摘要中文翻译）：近年来，基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐取得了进展，但往往依赖于物品-类别层面的常识增强或在现有知识图上进行隐式意图建模。然而，这类方法难以捕获有依据的用户意图，也难以应对稀疏与冷启动场景。本文提出基于LLM的意图知识图谱推荐器（IKGR），其构建以意图为中心的知识图谱：用户与物品均被显式连接到由无需调参、RAG引导的LLM流水线抽取的意图节点。通过将意图锚定在外部知识源与用户画像中，IKGR把“用户想要什么”与“物品满足什么”以一等实体形式规范表示。为缓解稀疏，我们进一步提出互意图连通性增密策略，在无需跨图融合的情况下缩短用户与长尾物品之间的语义路径。最后，在意图增强图上使用轻量GNN层，以低时延产生推荐信号。在公开与企业数据集上的大量实验表明，IKGR持续优于强基线，尤其在冷启动与长尾切片上表现突出，并通过全离线的LLM流水线保持效率。
AI.summary: 论文围绕“稀疏连接+知识缺口”下推荐难题，提出IKGR：用无需微调的RAG式LLM从用户画像与外部知识中抽取可解释、可落地的意图，并把意图作为知识图谱的核心节点连接用户与物品；再用互意图增密缩短用户到长尾物品的路径，最后以轻量GNN输出推荐结果。实验在公开与企业数据上验证其整体优于强基线，冷启动/长尾收益显著，同时因LLM离线与轻量模型保持效率与低延迟。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型; 推荐系统; 意图抽取; RAG检索增强生成; 知识图谱; 冷启动; 长尾推荐; 图神经网络; 稀疏连接; 离线推理
AI.comments: 优点：1) 将“意图”显式实体化并与外部知识对齐，增强可解释性与可迁移性；2) 互意图增密针对长尾/稀疏有明确机制；3) LLM全离线+轻量GNN兼顾效果与时延。局限/待澄清：Not mentioned in abstract（如意图抽取的具体提示/检索源、增密规则细节、GNN结构与训练目标、消融与误差分析、不同LLM的敏感性与成本评估、隐私与安全处理等未在摘要给出）。

title: A large-scale analysis of public-facing, community-built chatbots on Character.AI
summary: This paper presents the first large-scale analysis of public-facing chatbots on Character.AI, a rapidly growing social media platform where users create and interact with chatbots. Character.AI is distinctive in that it merges generative AI with user-generated content, enabling users to build bots for others to engage with. It is also popular, with over 20 million monthly active users, and impactful, with headlines detailing significant issues with youth engagement on the site. Character.AI is thus of interest to study both substantively and conceptually. To this end, we present a descriptive overview using a dataset of 2.1 million English-language prompts (or "greetings") from chatbots on the site, created by around 1 million users. Our work explores the prevalence of different fandoms on the site, broader tropes that persist across fandoms, and how dynamics of power intersect with gender within greetings. Overall, our findings illuminate an emerging form of online (para)social interaction at a unique and important intersection between generative AI and user-generated content.

AI.title_translation: 对 Character.AI 上面向公众的社区构建聊天机器人的大规模分析
AI.tldr: 论文对 Character.AI 上公开可交互、由社区用户构建的聊天机器人进行首次大规模描述性分析，基于 210 万条英文“问候/开场提示”，考察站内同人/粉丝圈（fandom）分布、跨圈层叙事套路（tropes），以及问候语中性别与权力动态的交织，揭示生成式 AI 与用户生成内容结合下的新型线上（准）社会互动形态。
AI.motivation: Character.AI 作为将生成式 AI 与用户生成内容融合、且拥有超 2000 万月活并引发青少年参与等社会问题讨论的平台，具有重要的实质与概念研究价值，需要系统性的大规模实证描述来理解其内容生态与互动模式。
AI.method: 使用来自 Character.AI 的数据集进行描述性概览分析：包含 210 万条英文聊天机器人“greetings”（开场提示/问候语），由约 100 万名用户创建；分析主题包括不同 fandom 的流行程度、跨 fandom 的常见 tropes、以及 greetings 中权力动态与性别的交互关系。
AI.result: 发现并刻画了：站内不同 fandom 的流行分布特征；跨 fandom 持续存在的更广泛叙事/角色套路（tropes）；以及在开场问候语中权力关系如何与性别维度相互交织（具体统计细节未在摘要中展开）。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了在生成式 AI 与用户生成内容交汇处出现的一种新兴线上（准）社会互动形式，并表明 Character.AI 作为重要平台值得进一步研究其社会影响与内容/互动结构。
AI.translation: 本文首次对 Character.AI 上面向公众的聊天机器人进行大规模分析。Character.AI 是一个快速增长的社交媒体平台，用户在其中创建并与聊天机器人互动。其独特之处在于将生成式 AI 与用户生成内容结合，使用户能够构建供他人互动的机器人。该平台也非常流行（每月活跃用户超过 2000 万），并因与青少年参与相关的重大问题见诸报道而具有影响力。因此，Character.AI 在实质层面与概念层面都值得研究。为此，我们基于一个描述性数据概览，使用了来自网站聊天机器人的 210 万条英文提示语（或称“问候语”）数据，这些机器人由约 100 万名用户创建。我们的工作探讨了网站上不同粉丝圈（fandom）的普遍程度、跨粉丝圈持续存在的更广泛叙事套路（tropes），以及权力动态如何在问候语中与性别相交织。总体而言，我们的发现阐明了一种新兴的线上（准）社会互动形式，处于生成式 AI 与用户生成内容这一独特且重要的交汇点。
AI.summary: 论文围绕 Character.AI 这一融合生成式 AI 与 UGC 的社交平台，构建并分析了覆盖面广的数据集（210 万条英文机器人开场问候语、约 100 万创建者），从内容生态（fandom 分布与共通套路）与社会结构维度（性别与权力关系的呈现）对公开可交互的社区构建聊天机器人进行整体性描绘，强调其所代表的新型（准）社会互动及平台社会影响的重要性。
AI.keywords: Character.AI；聊天机器人；生成式AI；用户生成内容（UGC）；大规模分析；描述性研究；问候语/开场提示（greetings）；粉丝圈（fandom）；叙事套路（tropes）；性别；权力动态；（准）社会互动；社交媒体平台
AI.comments: 摘要未说明具体分析方法细节（如分类方案、模型/编码流程、统计指标、因果推断与否）以及定量结果的具体数值；数据范围限定为英文 greetings，可能影响对非英语内容与其他交互文本（对话内容本身）的外推；研究定位为“描述性概览”，更偏生态刻画而非机制解释。

title: Structured Agent Distillation for Large Language Model
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong capabilities as decision-making agents by interleaving reasoning and actions, as seen in ReAct-style frameworks. Yet, their practical deployment is constrained by high inference costs and large model sizes. We propose Structured Agent Distillation, a framework that compresses large LLM-based agents into smaller student models while preserving both reasoning fidelity and action consistency. Unlike standard token-level distillation, our method segments trajectories into {[REASON]} and {[ACT]} spans, applying segment-specific losses to align each component with the teacher's behavior. This structure-aware supervision enables compact agents to better replicate the teacher's decision process. Experiments on ALFWorld, HotPotQA-ReAct, and WebShop show that our approach consistently outperforms token-level and imitation learning baselines, achieving significant compression with minimal performance drop. Scaling and ablation results further highlight the importance of span-level alignment for efficient and deployable agents.

AI.title_translation: 用于大语言模型的结构化智能体蒸馏
AI.tldr: 提出结构化智能体蒸馏，将教师LLM智能体的轨迹按[REASON]/[ACT]分段并施加分段损失，使小模型在显著压缩下尽量保持推理与行动一致性，并在多项ReAct任务上优于token级蒸馏与模仿学习基线。
AI.motivation: LLM作为决策智能体虽强，但部署受高推理成本与大模型体积限制；需要在压缩模型的同时保留推理过程的保真度与行动一致性。
AI.method: Structured Agent Distillation：将智能体轨迹分割为[REASON]推理片段与[ACT]行动片段；对不同片段使用“segment-specific losses”进行结构感知监督，以分别对齐学生与教师在推理与行动上的行为；对比标准token级蒸馏与模仿学习基线，并进行规模化与消融分析验证span级对齐的作用。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、HotPotQA-ReAct、WebShop上，相比token级蒸馏与模仿学习基线取得一致更优表现；在显著压缩的同时性能下降很小；规模化与消融结果显示span级对齐对效率与可部署性很重要。
AI.conclusion: 结构化（推理/行动分段）蒸馏能让小型学生智能体更好复现教师的决策过程，在保持性能的同时实现更高效、可部署的智能体压缩。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）通过交错推理与行动（如ReAct框架）展现出强大的决策智能体能力，但实际部署受高推理成本与模型规模限制。我们提出结构化智能体蒸馏（Structured Agent Distillation），在保持推理保真度与行动一致性的前提下，将基于大型LLM的智能体压缩为更小的学生模型。不同于标准的token级蒸馏，我们将轨迹切分为[REASON]与[ACT]片段，并对不同片段施加特定损失，以对齐学生与教师的对应行为。该结构感知监督使紧凑智能体更好复现教师的决策过程。在ALFWorld、HotPotQA-ReAct与WebShop上的实验表明，我们的方法稳定优于token级蒸馏与模仿学习基线，在显著压缩下仅带来很小的性能损失。进一步的规模化与消融实验凸显了片段级对齐对高效可部署智能体的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM智能体部署成本高的问题，提出一种结构感知的蒸馏框架：把教师智能体的交错“推理-行动”轨迹显式分为推理段与行动段，分别用对应损失对齐，从而让小模型不仅学到输出token，还能更好复现决策结构。实验覆盖ALFWorld、HotPotQA-ReAct、WebShop，结果显示该方法在大幅压缩模型的同时，相比token级蒸馏与模仿学习基线更稳健且性能损失更小，并通过消融/规模化验证span级对齐的关键性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型; 智能体; 蒸馏; 结构化监督; ReAct; 轨迹分段; 推理-行动对齐; 模型压缩; ALFWorld; HotPotQA-ReAct; WebShop
AI.comments: 创新点在于将智能体轨迹按推理/行动显式分段并进行分段损失对齐，直指token级蒸馏难以同时保留“思考”和“执行”一致性的问题；摘要未提及具体损失形式、学生/教师模型规模、训练细节与具体数值提升幅度。

title: Let's Verify Math Questions Step by Step
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress in mathematical reasoning. To enable such capabilities, many existing works distill strong reasoning models into long chains of thought or design algorithms to construct high-quality math question-answer (QA) data for training. However, these efforts primarily focus on generating correct reasoning paths and answers, while largely overlooking the correctness of the questions themselves. In this work, we present ValiMath, a benchmark consisting of 2147 human-verified mathematical questions covering a wide range of domains such as arithmetic, algebra, and geometry, which are synthesized and curated from the NuminaMath dataset. Each question is annotated with its logical structure, domain coverage, and question correctness, enabling fine-grained evaluation of question quality. ValiMath serves as a high-quality gold-standard test set for validating mathematical questions in LLM training corpora. Building upon this benchmark, we further propose MathQ-Verify, a pipeline that performs fine-grained parsing of mathematical questions into atomic assumptions and conclusions, and evaluates their semantic soundness through consistency checks. This pipeline achieves high precision in detecting flawed questions and provides a reliable foundation for cleaning noisy mathematical datasets. Experiments show that MathQ-Verify achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, improving the F1 score by up to 25 percentage points over the direct verification baseline. MathQ-Verify offers a scalable and accurate solution for curating reliable mathematical datasets, reducing label noise and avoiding unnecessary computation on invalid questions. Our code and data are available at the repository https://github.com/OpenDCAI/MathQ-Verify.

AI.title_translation: 让我们一步步验证数学问题
AI.tldr: 论文提出人工核验的数学题目基准ValiMath，并在此基础上提出MathQ-Verify管线，将题目解析为原子假设/结论并做一致性检查，以高精度发现题目本身的缺陷；在多基准上达到SOTA，F1最高提升25个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有数学推理研究多关注生成正确的推理链与答案，但忽视训练语料中“题目本身是否正确”。错误题目会带来标签噪声与无谓计算，因此需要可用于验证题目正确性的高质量基准与自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建ValiMath基准：从NuminaMath合成与整理，包含2147道人类验证的数学题，覆盖算术/代数/几何等；为每题标注逻辑结构、领域覆盖与题目正确性，用于细粒度评估题目质量。2) 提出MathQ-Verify：将数学题细粒度解析为原子假设与结论，并通过一致性检查评估语义健全性，从而检测题目缺陷；用于清洗含噪数学数据集。
AI.result: MathQ-Verify在检测有缺陷题目方面具有高精度；在多个基准上取得SOTA，相比“直接验证”基线方法，F1最高提升25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ValiMath可作为验证LLM训练语料中数学题目质量的高质量金标准测试集；MathQ-Verify提供可扩展且准确的题目验证与数据清洗方案，可降低标签噪声并避免在无效题目上浪费计算。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM数学训练语料中“题目可能本身有错”的被忽视问题，提出两项贡献：其一是由2147道人类核验题组成的ValiMath基准，带有逻辑结构、领域与正确性标注，便于细粒度评测题目质量；其二是MathQ-Verify自动验证管线，将题目解析为原子假设与结论并做一致性/语义健全性检查，从而高精度识别缺陷题。实验表明该方法在多基准上达SOTA，F1最高提升25个百分点，可用于规模化清洗噪声数学数据集。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型; 数学推理; 题目验证; 数据集清洗; 基准测试; ValiMath; MathQ-Verify; 一致性检查; 语义健全性; 逻辑结构标注
AI.comments: 亮点在于把关注点从“答案/推理是否正确”前移到“问题是否成立”，并提供人工核验金标准与自动化验证流程；抽象未说明一致性检查的具体形式化规则、使用的解析器/模型细节与计算开销分布，也未给出各基准名称与绝对指标，仅报告最高F1增益。代码与数据在给定GitHub仓库开源。

title: AudioTrust: Benchmarking the Multifaceted Trustworthiness of Audio Large Language Models
summary: The rapid development and widespread adoption of Audio Large Language Models (ALLMs) demand rigorous evaluation of their trustworthiness. However, existing evaluation frameworks are primarily designed for text and fail to capture vulnerabilities introduced by the acoustic properties of audio. We find that significant trustworthiness risks in ALLMs arise from non-semantic acoustic cues, such as timbre, accent, and background noise, which can be exploited to manipulate model behavior. To address this gap, we propose AudioTrust, the first large-scale and systematic framework for evaluating ALLM trustworthiness under audio-specific risks. AudioTrust covers six key dimensions: fairness, hallucination, safety, privacy, robustness, and authenticition. It includes 26 sub-tasks and a curated dataset of more than 4,420 audio samples collected from real-world scenarios, including daily conversations, emergency calls, and voice assistant interactions, and is specifically designed to probe trustworthiness across multiple dimensions. Our comprehensive evaluation spans 18 experimental settings and uses human-validated automated pipelines to enable objective and scalable assessment of model outputs. Experimental results on 14 state-of-the-art open-source and closed-source ALLMs reveal important limitations and failure boundaries under diverse high-risk audio scenarios, providing critical insights for the secure and trustworthy deployment of future audio models. Our platform and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/JusperLee/AudioTrust.

AI.title_translation: AudioTrust：面向音频大语言模型多维度可信性的基准评测
AI.tldr: 提出AudioTrust这一首个面向音频大语言模型（ALLMs）的音频特定可信性评测框架与基准数据集，从公平性、幻觉、安全、隐私、鲁棒性、真实性六维度系统测试模型在口音、音色、噪声等非语义声学线索下的风险与失效边界。
AI.motivation: 现有可信性评测框架主要为文本设计，无法覆盖音频固有声学属性带来的新型脆弱性；ALLMs会受到音色、口音、背景噪声等非语义线索影响并被利用来操纵模型行为，因此需要专门的音频可信性评测体系。
AI.method: 提出AudioTrust大规模系统评测框架：覆盖6个维度（公平性、幻觉、安全、隐私、鲁棒性、真实性），包含26个子任务；构建包含4420+来自真实场景（日常对话、紧急呼叫、语音助手交互等）的音频样本数据集；在18种实验设置下对模型进行评测，并采用“人工验证的自动化流水线”以实现客观、可扩展的输出评估；对14个开源与闭源SOTA ALLMs进行基准测试；平台与基准开源发布。
AI.result: 在14个SOTA开源/闭源ALLMs上的实验显示：模型在多种高风险音频场景下存在显著局限与失效边界，暴露出由非语义声学线索引发的多维可信性风险；评测结果为未来音频模型的安全可信部署提供关键洞见。
AI.conclusion: AudioTrust填补了ALLMs在音频特定风险下可信性评测的空白，能够以大规模、系统化方式揭示模型在真实高风险音频场景中的限制与失败边界，并为安全可信的模型部署提供参考；基准与平台已公开。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 本文指出音频大语言模型的可信性风险不仅来自语义内容，还可能由音色、口音、背景噪声等非语义声学线索触发并被利用。为此作者提出AudioTrust评测框架与基准：围绕公平性、幻觉、安全、隐私、鲁棒性、真实性六大维度设计26项子任务，收集4420+真实场景音频并在18种设置下用人工验证的自动评测流水线对14个SOTA模型进行系统测试。结果揭示了ALLMs在多类高风险音频条件下的明显不足与失效边界，支撑未来更安全可信的音频模型研发与部署。
AI.keywords: 音频大语言模型(ALLMs), 可信性评测, 基准测试, 非语义声学线索, 音色, 口音, 背景噪声, 公平性, 幻觉, 安全, 隐私, 鲁棒性, 真实性(Authenticition), 数据集, 自动化评测流水线
AI.comments: 亮点：强调音频模态特有的非语义线索攻击面，提供首个系统化大规模ALLM可信性基准；覆盖维度全面并包含真实场景数据与多实验设置。可能不足：摘要未给出各模型的定量指标、具体失效案例或“authenticition”定义与测量细节；数据集构成分布与标注协议在摘要中未说明。

title: Hiding in Plain Sight: A Steganographic Approach to Stealthy LLM Jailbreaks
summary: Jailbreak attacks pose a serious threat to Large Language Models (LLMs) by bypassing their safety mechanisms. A truly advanced jailbreak is defined not only by its effectiveness but, more critically, by its stealthiness. However, existing methods face a fundamental trade-off between semantic stealth (hiding malicious intent) and linguistic stealth (appearing natural), leaving them vulnerable to detection. To resolve this trade-off, we propose StegoAttack, a framework that leverages steganography. The core insight is to embed a harmful query within a benign, semantically coherent paragraph. This design provides semantic stealth by concealing the existence of malicious content and ensures linguistic stealth by maintaining the natural fluency of the cover paragraph. We evaluate StegoAttack on four state-of-the-art, safety-aligned LLMs, including GPT-5 and Gemini-3, and benchmark it against eight leading jailbreak methods. Our results show that StegoAttack achieves an average attack success rate (ASR) of 95.50%, outperforming existing baselines across all four models. Critically, its ASR drops by less than 27.00% under external detectors, while maintaining natural language distribution. This demonstrates that steganography effectively decouples linguistic and semantic stealth, thereby posing a fully concealed yet highly effective security threat. The code is available at https://github.com/GenggengSvan/StegoAttack

AI.title_translation: 明藏于显：一种用于隐蔽 LLM 越狱的隐写术方法
AI.tldr: 提出 StegoAttack：用隐写术把有害请求嵌入看似无害且通顺的段落中，以同时获得语义隐蔽与语言隐蔽；在 GPT-5、Gemini-3 等 4 个模型上平均 ASR 达 95.50%，在外部检测器下 ASR 下降小于 27.00%。
AI.motivation: 现有越狱方法在“语义隐蔽（隐藏恶意意图）”与“语言隐蔽（表面自然流畅）”之间存在根本性权衡，导致容易被检测；需要一种能同时兼顾两类隐蔽性的更隐蔽越狱方式。
AI.method: StegoAttack 框架：利用隐写术将有害查询嵌入到一段良性、语义连贯的自然语言掩护段落中；通过“掩护文本的自然性”保证语言隐蔽，通过“恶意内容存在性被隐藏”实现语义隐蔽，并用该设计来解耦两类隐蔽性。
AI.result: 在 4 个安全对齐的 SOTA LLM（含 GPT-5、Gemini-3）上评测，并与 8 种主流越狱方法对比：平均攻击成功率（ASR）为 95.50%，在四个模型上均优于基线；在外部检测器下 ASR 下降小于 27.00%，且保持自然语言分布。
AI.conclusion: 隐写术可有效解耦语言隐蔽与语义隐蔽，使越狱攻击在“完全隐藏”情况下仍保持高成功率，从而构成更严峻的安全威胁。
AI.translation: 越狱攻击通过绕过安全机制对大型语言模型（LLM）构成严重威胁。真正先进的越狱不仅取决于有效性，更关键在于隐蔽性。然而，现有方法在语义隐蔽（隐藏恶意意图）与语言隐蔽（表面自然）之间存在根本性权衡，因此容易被检测。为解决这一权衡，我们提出 StegoAttack，一个利用隐写术的框架。其核心思想是将有害查询嵌入到一段良性、语义连贯的段落中。该设计通过隐藏恶意内容的存在提供语义隐蔽，并通过保持掩护段落的自然流畅确保语言隐蔽。我们在四个最先进、经过安全对齐的 LLM（包括 GPT-5 和 Gemini-3）上评估 StegoAttack，并与八种领先的越狱方法进行基准对比。结果表明，StegoAttack 的平均攻击成功率（ASR）达到 95.50%，在四个模型上均优于现有基线。关键的是，在外部检测器下其 ASR 下降不到 27.00%，同时保持自然语言分布。这表明隐写术能够有效解耦语言与语义隐蔽性，从而带来一种完全隐蔽但高度有效的安全威胁。代码地址：https://github.com/GenggengSvan/StegoAttack
AI.summary: 论文将“隐蔽性”视为高阶越狱的核心指标，指出既有方法在语义与语言隐蔽之间难以兼得。为此提出基于隐写的 StegoAttack，把有害指令以隐蔽方式嵌入良性自然段落中，从而既不暴露恶意意图也保持文本自然。实验在包括 GPT-5、Gemini-3 在内的 4 个安全对齐模型上显示其 ASR 平均 95.50%，对比 8 类基线全面领先，并在外部检测器介入时仍保持较高鲁棒性（ASR 降幅 <27%），提示隐写式越狱带来更难发现的安全风险。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型安全, 越狱攻击, 隐写术, 隐蔽性, 攻击成功率, 外部检测器, 对齐模型, StegoAttack
AI.comments: 贡献：用隐写术思路系统化解决语义/语言隐蔽权衡，并给出跨 4 模型、对 8 基线的强实证结果。影响：提示现有检测与对齐机制可能难以发现“看似良性”的载体文本。局限与细节：嵌入/解码机制、检测器类型与评测协议等具体实现细节在摘要中未展开；对防御策略的具体建议不在摘要中。

title: {log}: From a Constraint Logic Programming Language to a Formal Verification Tool
comments: Under consideration in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP)
summary: {log} (read 'setlog') was born as a Constraint Logic Programming (CLP) language where sets and binary relations are first-class citizens, thus fostering set programming. Internally, {log} is a constraint satisfiability solver implementing decision procedures for several fragments of set theory. Hence, {log} can be used as a declarative, set, logic programming language and as an automated theorem prover for set theory. Over time {log} has been extended with some components integrated to the satisfiability solver thus providing a formal verification environment. In this paper we make a comprehensive presentation of this environment which includes a language for the description of state machines based on set theory, an interactive environment for the execution of functional scenarios over state machines, a generator of verification conditions for state machines, automated verification of state machines, and test case generation. State machines are both, programs and specifications; exactly the same code works as a program and as its specification. In this way, with a few additions, a CLP language turned into a seamlessly integrated programming and automated proof system.

title: The Coherence Trap: When MLLM-Crafted Narratives Exploit Manipulated Visual Contexts
summary: The detection and grounding of multimedia manipulation has emerged as a critical challenge in combating AI-generated disinformation. While existing methods have made progress in recent years, we identify two fundamental limitations in current approaches: (1) Underestimation of MLLM-driven deception risk: prevailing techniques primarily address rule-based text manipulations, yet fail to account for sophisticated misinformation synthesized by multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that can dynamically generate semantically coherent, contextually plausible yet deceptive narratives conditioned on manipulated images; (2) Unrealistic misalignment artifacts: currently focused scenarios rely on artificially misaligned content that lacks semantic coherence, rendering them easily detectable. To address these gaps holistically, we propose a new adversarial pipeline that leverages MLLMs to generate high-risk disinformation. Our approach begins with constructing the MLLM-Driven Synthetic Multimodal (MDSM) dataset, where images are first altered using state-of-the-art editing techniques and then paired with MLLM-generated deceptive texts that maintain semantic consistency with the visual manipulations. Building upon this foundation, we present the Artifact-aware Manipulation Diagnosis via MLLM (AMD) framework featuring two key innovations: Artifact Pre-perception Encoding strategy and Manipulation-Oriented Reasoning, to tame MLLMs for the MDSM problem. Comprehensive experiments validate our framework's superior generalization capabilities as a unified architecture for detecting MLLM-powered multimodal deceptions. In cross-domain testing on the MDSM dataset, AMD achieves the best average performance, with 88.18 ACC, 60.25 mAP, and 61.02 mIoU scores.

AI.title_translation: 一致性陷阱：当多模态大语言模型（MLLM）生成的叙事利用被操控的视觉上下文

AI.method: 提出一套端到端对抗式流程：1) 构建MDSM（MLLM-Driven Synthetic Multimodal）数据集：先用SOTA图像编辑技术篡改图像，再配对由MLLM生成、与视觉篡改保持语义一致的欺骗文本；2) 在此基础上提出AMD（Artifact-aware Manipulation Diagnosis via MLLM）统一框架，包含两项关键设计：伪影预感知编码（Artifact Pre-perception Encoding）与面向操控的推理（Manipulation-Oriented Reasoning），用于“驯化”MLLM以解决MDSM场景下的检测与定位问题。
AI.result: 综合实验显示AMD作为统一架构具有更强泛化能力；在MDSM数据集的跨域测试中取得最佳平均表现：88.18 ACC、60.25 mAP、61.02 mIoU。

title: TextFlux: An OCR-Free DiT Model for High-Fidelity Multilingual Scene Text Synthesis
summary: Diffusion-based scene text synthesis has progressed rapidly, yet existing methods commonly rely on additional visual conditioning modules and require large-scale annotated data to support multilingual generation. In this work, we revisit the necessity of complex auxiliary modules and further explore an approach that simultaneously ensures glyph accuracy and achieves high-fidelity scene integration, by leveraging diffusion models' inherent capabilities for contextual reasoning. To this end, we introduce TextFlux, a DiT-based framework that enables multilingual scene text synthesis. The advantages of TextFlux can be summarized as follows: (1) OCR-free model architecture. TextFlux eliminates the need for OCR encoders (additional visual conditioning modules) that are specifically used to extract visual text-related features. (2) Strong multilingual scalability. TextFlux is effective in low-resource multilingual settings, and achieves strong performance in newly added languages with fewer than 1,000 samples. (3) Streamlined training setup. TextFlux is trained with only 1% of the training data required by competing methods. (4) Controllable multi-line text generation. TextFlux offers flexible multi-line synthesis with precise line-level control, outperforming methods restricted to single-line or rigid layouts. Extensive experiments and visualizations demonstrate that TextFlux outperforms previous methods in both qualitative and quantitative evaluations.

title: Geometric SSM: LTI State Space Models for Selective Tasks
summary: A key claim in recent work on Selective State Space Models is that selectivity, the ability to focus on relevant information while filtering irrelevant inputs, requires breaking the Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) property through time-varying dynamics. We challenge this claim by demonstrating that LTI systems can achieve selectivity when designed using principles from geometric control. We introduce the Geometric SSM, in which different input patterns excite distinct invariant subspaces of the dynamics. Unlike Mamba's memoryless selection mechanism, our approach employs a dynamic residual generator that maintains temporal memory, enabling recognition of multi-token patterns without time-varying system matrices. The Geometric SSM achieves near-perfect performance on a novel extended induction head task where Mamba fails, while preserving efficient FFT-based training. Our results demonstrate that geometric control theory can inform the design of novel selective sequence models that combine theoretical rigor with practical efficiency.

title: Strictly Constrained Generative Modeling via Split Augmented Langevin Sampling
summary: Deep generative models hold great promise for representing complex physical systems, but their deployment is currently limited by the lack of guarantees on the physical plausibility of the generated outputs. Ensuring that known physical constraints are enforced is therefore critical when applying generative models to scientific and engineering problems. We address this limitation by developing a principled framework for sampling from a target distribution while rigorously satisfying mathematical constraints. Leveraging the variational formulation of Langevin dynamics and Lagrangian duality, we propose Constrained Alternated Split Augmented Langevin (CASAL), a novel primal-dual sampling algorithm that enforces constraints progressively through variable splitting. We analyze our algorithm in Wasserstein space and derive explicit mixing time rates. While the method is developed theoretically for Langevin dynamics, we demonstrate its applicability to diffusion models. We apply our method to diffusion-based data assimilation on a complex physical system, where enforcing physical constraints substantially improves both forecast accuracy and the preservation of critical conserved quantities. We also demonstrate the potential of CASAL for challenging non-convex feasibility problems in optimal control.

AI.title_translation: 通过分裂增广朗之万采样实现严格约束的生成建模
AI.tldr: 提出CASAL（一种基于变分朗之万动力学与拉格朗日对偶的原始-对偶采样算法），通过变量分裂逐步强化约束，在采样目标分布的同时严格满足数学/物理约束，并给出Wasserstein空间下的混合时间率；在扩散模型上的数据同化与最优控制可行性问题中显示出更好的物理一致性与性能。
AI.motivation: 深度生成模型用于复杂物理系统时缺乏对生成结果物理可行性的保证；科学与工程应用需要严格满足已知物理/数学约束，因此需要一种在采样过程中可证明地强制约束的生成/采样框架。
AI.method: 利用朗之万动力学的变分表述与拉格朗日对偶，提出Constrained Alternated Split Augmented Langevin（CASAL）原始-对偶采样算法；通过变量分裂（split augmented）与交替更新，逐步（progressively）施加并强化约束；在Wasserstein空间中进行理论分析并推导显式混合时间（mixing time）速率；并将该理论方法用于扩散模型的约束采样/生成。
AI.result: 理论上：在Wasserstein空间分析CASAL并得到显式混合时间率。实证上：在基于扩散模型的复杂物理系统数据同化中，施加物理约束显著提升预测精度并更好保持关键守恒量；在最优控制的困难非凸可行性问题中展示了CASAL的潜力。
AI.conclusion: CASAL为严格约束下的目标分布采样提供了有理论保证的原始-对偶框架，既给出混合时间率等理论性质，也能迁移到扩散模型等现代生成模型应用中，从而在物理约束生成、数据同化与最优控制等任务中改善物理一致性与性能。

title: Diffusion Blend: Inference-Time Multi-Preference Alignment for Diffusion Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have been used recently to align diffusion models with downstream objectives such as aesthetic quality and text-image consistency by fine-tuning them to maximize a single reward function under a fixed KL regularization. However, this approach is inherently restrictive in practice, where alignment must balance multiple, often conflicting objectives. Moreover, user preferences vary across prompts, individuals, and deployment contexts, with varying tolerances for deviation from a pre-trained base model. We address the problem of inference-time multi-preference alignment: given a set of basis reward functions and a reference KL regularization strength, can we design a fine-tuning procedure so that, at inference time, it can generate images aligned with any user-specified linear combination of rewards and regularization, without requiring additional fine-tuning? We propose Diffusion Blend, a novel approach to solve inference-time multi-preference alignment by blending backward diffusion processes associated with fine-tuned models, and we instantiate this approach with two algorithms: DB-MPA for multi-reward alignment and DB-KLA for KL regularization control. Extensive experiments show that Diffusion Blend algorithms consistently outperform relevant baselines and closely match or exceed the performance of individually fine-tuned models, enabling efficient, user-driven alignment at inference-time. The code is available at https://github.com/bluewoods127/DB-2025.

AI.title_translation: 扩散融合：用于扩散模型的推理时多偏好对齐
AI.tldr: 提出Diffusion Blend，在推理时通过融合多个已微调模型对应的反向扩散过程，实现对多奖励（多目标）与KL正则强度的可控对齐，无需为每种用户偏好再次微调，且实验优于基线并接近/超过单独微调模型表现。
AI.motivation: 现有用RL微调扩散模型的方法通常在固定KL正则下只优化单一奖励，难以应对实际中多目标且可能冲突的对齐需求；同时用户偏好随提示词、个体与部署场景变化，并且对偏离预训练基座模型的容忍度（KL强度）也不同，因此需要支持推理时按需调整的多偏好对齐能力。
AI.method: 定义“推理时多偏好对齐”问题：给定一组基础奖励函数与参考KL强度，设计一种微调流程，使模型在推理时可对任意用户指定的奖励线性组合与正则强度进行对齐且无需额外微调；提出Diffusion Blend，通过融合与不同微调模型相关联的反向扩散过程来实现推理时对齐控制；并给出两种实例化算法：DB-MPA（多奖励对齐）与DB-KLA（KL正则强度控制）。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Diffusion Blend系列算法稳定优于相关基线，并且表现与分别针对特定目标单独微调的模型相近或更好，从而实现高效的、用户驱动的推理时对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过在推理阶段融合多个微调模型的反向扩散过程，可以在无需再次微调的情况下，实现对多奖励偏好与KL正则强度的灵活控制，提升多偏好对齐的实用性与效率。

title: From Entity-Centric to Goal-Oriented Graphs: Enhancing LLM Knowledge Retrieval in Minecraft
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive general capabilities but often struggle with step-by-step procedural reasoning, a critical challenge in complex interactive environments. While retrieval-augmented methods like GraphRAG attempt to bridge this gap, their fragmented entity-relation graphs hinder the construction of coherent, multi-step plans. In this paper, we propose a novel framework based on Goal-Oriented Graphs (GoGs), where each node represents a goal and edges encode logical dependencies between them. This structure enables the explicit retrieval of causal reasoning paths by identifying a high-level goal and recursively retrieving its prerequisites, forming a coherent chain to guide the LLM. Through extensive experiments on the Minecraft testbed, a domain that demands robust multi-step planning and provides rich procedural knowledge, we demonstrate that GoG substantially improves procedural reasoning and significantly outperforms GraphRAG and other state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.title_translation: 从以实体为中心到以目标为导向的图：增强LLM在《我的世界》中的知识检索
AI.tldr: 提出目标导向图（GoG），用“目标-依赖”结构替代碎片化实体关系图，通过递归检索前置条件形成因果推理链，在Minecraft多步规划任务上显著优于GraphRAG等方法。
AI.motivation: LLM虽具通用能力，但在复杂交互环境中的逐步程序推理（多步规划）上表现不足；现有GraphRAG等检索增强方法使用碎片化的实体-关系图，难以构建连贯的多步计划。

AI.result: 在Minecraft测试平台的大量实验中，GoG显著提升程序性推理能力，并在性能上显著超越GraphRAG及其他SOTA基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将知识组织从实体中心转为目标中心、并显式建模目标依赖关系，可更有效检索因果推理链，从而提升LLM在需要多步规划的交互式环境中的推理表现。

title: ReasonMap: Towards Fine-Grained Visual Reasoning from Transit Maps
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant progress in semantic scene understanding and text-image alignment, with reasoning variants enhancing performance on more complex tasks involving mathematics and logic. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReasonMap, a novel benchmark specifically designed to evaluate these capabilities. ReasonMap encompasses high-resolution transit maps from 30 cities and includes 1,008 question-answer pairs spanning two question types and three templates. Furthermore, we design a two-level evaluation pipeline that properly assesses answer correctness and quality. Our comprehensive evaluation of 16 popular MLLMs reveals a counterintuitive pattern: among open-source models, base variants outperform their reasoning-tuned counterparts, whereas the opposite trend is observed in closed-source models. Further analysis under the visual-masking setting confirms that strong performance necessitates direct visual grounding, rather than relying solely on language priors. We further establish a training baseline with reinforcement fine-tuning, providing a reference for future exploration. We hope this benchmark study offers new insights into visual reasoning and helps investigate the gap between open- and closed-source models.

AI.title_translation: ReasonMap：迈向从公交/轨道交通地图进行细粒度视觉推理
AI.tldr: 提出细粒度交通地图视觉推理基准ReasonMap（30城高分辨率地图、1008组问答），并评测16个MLLM，发现开源模型中基础版优于推理调优版，而闭源模型相反；视觉遮罩实验表明需要直接视觉落地；提供强化微调训练基线。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在语义理解与图文对齐上进步显著，但在涉及数学/逻辑等更复杂推理任务上的能力评估与提升仍存在缺口，需要一个专门衡量细粒度“看图推理”的基准来弥合该差距。
AI.method: 构建ReasonMap基准：收集30个城市的高分辨率公共交通地图；标注1008个问答对，覆盖2种问题类型与3种模板；提出两级评测流程以同时评估答案正确性与质量；对16个主流MLLM进行系统评测；在视觉遮罩（visual-masking）设置下做分析；并建立基于强化学习的微调训练基线。
AI.result: 对16个MLLM的评测显示反直觉规律：开源模型中基础版本优于推理调优版本；闭源模型则相反。视觉遮罩分析进一步表明高性能需要直接的视觉 grounding，而不能仅依赖语言先验。
AI.conclusion: ReasonMap可为细粒度交通地图视觉推理提供新的评测视角与洞见；结果揭示开源与闭源模型在“推理调优收益”上的差异，并强调视觉落地的重要性；强化微调基线为后续研究提供参考。

title: CreatiDesign: A Unified Multi-Conditional Diffusion Transformer for Creative Graphic Design
summary: Graphic design plays a vital role in visual communication across advertising, marketing, and multimedia entertainment. Prior work has explored automated graphic design generation using diffusion models, aiming to streamline creative workflows and democratize design capabilities. However, complex graphic design scenarios require accurately adhering to design intent specified by multiple heterogeneous user-provided elements (\eg images, layouts, and texts), which pose multi-condition control challenges for existing methods. Specifically, previous single-condition control models demonstrate effectiveness only within their specialized domains but fail to generalize to other conditions, while existing multi-condition methods often lack fine-grained control over each sub-condition and compromise overall compositional harmony. To address these limitations, we introduce CreatiDesign, a systematic solution for automated graphic design covering both model architecture and dataset construction. First, we design a unified multi-condition driven architecture that enables flexible and precise integration of heterogeneous design elements with minimal architectural modifications to the base diffusion model. Furthermore, to ensure that each condition precisely controls its designated image region and to avoid interference between conditions, we propose a multimodal attention mask mechanism. Additionally, we develop a fully automated pipeline for constructing graphic design datasets, and introduce a new dataset with 400K samples featuring multi-condition annotations, along with a comprehensive benchmark. Experimental results show that CreatiDesign outperforms existing models by a clear margin in faithfully adhering to user intent.

AI.title_translation: CreatiDesign：用于创意平面图形设计的统一多条件扩散Transformer
AI.tldr: 提出CreatiDesign，一种统一的多条件扩散Transformer，通过多模态注意力掩码实现对图像、布局、文本等异构条件的细粒度区域控制，并配套自动化数据构建流程与40万规模多条件标注数据集；实验显示其在遵循用户设计意图方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式自动化平面设计在复杂场景下难以同时精确遵循多种异构用户输入（如图片、布局、文本）：单条件方法难以泛化到其他条件；多条件方法常缺乏对各子条件的细粒度控制且会破坏整体构图和谐。
AI.method: 1) 提出统一的多条件驱动架构：在尽量少改动基础扩散模型的前提下，灵活、精确融合多种异构设计元素；2) 提出多模态注意力掩码机制：确保每个条件只控制其指定区域并减少条件间干扰；3) 构建全自动数据集生成流水线，并发布包含40万样本、多条件标注的新数据集与综合基准。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CreatiDesign在忠实遵循用户意图方面相比现有模型有明显优势（“by a clear margin”）。
AI.conclusion: CreatiDesign通过统一多条件架构与多模态注意力掩码实现了更精确的多条件可控平面设计生成，并通过自动化数据构建与大规模基准支撑，整体上显著提升了对用户设计意图的遵循能力。
AI.translation: 平面设计在广告、营销和多媒体娱乐等视觉传播中至关重要。先前工作探索了利用扩散模型实现自动化平面设计生成，以简化创意流程并让设计能力更普及。然而，复杂平面设计需要准确遵循由多种异构用户元素（例如图片、布局和文本）指定的设计意图，这给现有方法带来了多条件控制挑战。具体而言，先前的单条件控制模型仅在各自专门领域有效，但难以泛化到其他条件；而现有多条件方法往往缺乏对每个子条件的细粒度控制，并牺牲整体构图和谐。为解决这些局限，我们提出CreatiDesign，一个覆盖模型架构与数据集构建的系统化自动平面设计方案。首先，我们设计了统一的多条件驱动架构，使得在对基础扩散模型进行最小架构改动的情况下，能够灵活且精确地整合异构设计元素。进一步地，为确保每个条件能精确控制其指定图像区域并避免条件间相互干扰，我们提出多模态注意力掩码机制。此外，我们开发了用于构建平面设计数据集的全自动流水线，并引入一个包含40万样本、带多条件标注的新数据集及综合基准。实验结果显示，CreatiDesign在忠实遵循用户意图方面显著优于现有模型。
AI.summary: 论文面向“多输入条件驱动的自动化平面设计生成”这一难题，提出CreatiDesign：在扩散Transformer框架下用统一架构整合图片/布局/文本等异构条件，并用多模态注意力掩码实现条件到指定区域的精确绑定与去干扰；同时提供自动化数据构建流程与40万规模多条件标注数据集/基准，实验验证其在遵循用户设计意图上明显领先。
AI.keywords: 平面设计生成, 扩散模型, Diffusion Transformer, 多条件控制, 异构条件融合, 多模态注意力掩码, 区域可控生成, 数据集构建, 基准测试, 用户意图遵循
AI.comments: 抽象未提及：具体网络细节（条件编码方式、训练目标/损失）、评测指标与对比方法列表、消融实验、推理成本与效率、数据集具体条件标注形式与质量控制、对“构图和谐”的量化定义与测量方法。

title: LLLMs: A Data-Driven Survey of Evolving Research on Limitations of Large Language Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) research has grown rapidly, along with increasing concern about their limitations. In this survey, we conduct a data-driven, semi-automated review of research on limitations of LLMs (LLLMs) from 2022 to early 2025 using a bottom-up approach. From a corpus of 250,000 ACL and arXiv papers, we identify 14,648 relevant papers using keyword filtering, LLM-based classification, validated against expert labels, and topic clustering (via two approaches, HDBSCAN+BERTopic and LlooM). We find that the share of LLM-related papers increases over fivefold in ACL and nearly eightfold in arXiv between 2022 and 2025. Since 2022, LLLMs research grows even faster, reaching over 30% of LLM papers by 2025. Reasoning remains the most studied limitation, followed by generalization, hallucination, bias, and security. The distribution of topics in the ACL dataset stays relatively stable over time, while arXiv shifts toward security risks, alignment, hallucinations, knowledge editing, and multimodality. We offer a quantitative view of trends in LLLMs research and release a dataset of annotated abstracts and a validated methodology, available at: https://github.com/a-kostikova/LLLMs-Survey.

AI.title_translation: LLLMs：基于数据驱动的关于大语言模型局限性研究演进的综述
AI.tldr: 本文对2022至2025年初关于大语言模型局限性（LLLMs）的研究进行数据驱动、半自动化综述：从25万篇ACL与arXiv论文中筛出14,648篇相关工作，量化了主题分布与时间趋势，并开源带标注摘要的数据集与可复现方法。
AI.motivation: LLM研究快速增长，同时对其局限性的担忧加剧；需要一种可量化、可扩展的方法来系统梳理LLM局限性研究的规模、主题与演化趋势。
AI.method: 数据驱动的半自动化自底向上综述流程：以2022至2025年初的ACL与arXiv共25万篇论文为语料；通过关键词过滤、基于LLM的分类（并用专家标注验证）、以及主题聚类两种方案（HDBSCAN+BERTopic 与 LlooM）识别并分析相关论文；最终得到14,648篇与LLM局限性相关的论文集合，并进行趋势与主题分布统计。
AI.result: （1）LLM相关论文占比在ACL从2022到2025年增长超过5倍，在arXiv增长近8倍；（2）自2022年以来，LLM局限性（LLLMs）研究增长更快，至2025年占全部LLM论文的30%以上；（3）最常被研究的局限性主题是推理，其次为泛化、幻觉、偏见与安全；（4）ACL数据集中主题分布随时间相对稳定，而arXiv在时间上更趋向于安全风险、对齐、幻觉、知识编辑与多模态等方向。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为LLM局限性研究提供了量化的趋势视角，并给出了经过验证的方法学与标注数据集，以支持后续对该领域的系统研究与复现分析。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 作者提出一套可扩展的半自动综述管线，对2022—2025年初ACL与arXiv中有关“大语言模型局限性”的研究进行识别、聚类与统计。通过关键词筛选、LLM分类并与专家标签校验，再结合两种主题聚类方法，构建出14,648篇相关论文集并量化演化趋势：LLM论文占比在两大来源显著增长，而局限性研究增长更快；推理是最核心的局限性议题，随后是泛化、幻觉、偏见与安全。不同平台呈现不同演化：ACL较稳定，arXiv更向安全、对齐、知识编辑与多模态等方向迁移。作者同时开源带标注摘要的数据集与验证过的方法。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型; 局限性; 数据驱动综述; 半自动化文献回顾; 主题聚类; HDBSCAN; BERTopic; LlooM; 幻觉; 推理; 偏见; 安全; 对齐; 知识编辑; 多模态; ACL; arXiv
AI.comments: 贡献集中在方法学与趋势量化：从大规模语料中以半自动流程抽取并聚类“局限性研究”，并对分类结果进行专家验证，提升可信度；同时提供可复现的开源数据集与代码/流程链接。局限：摘要未说明关键词表/分类标签体系的细节、专家标注规模与一致性指标、以及对“局限性”定义边界与误差分析的具体结果。

title: Your Classifier Can Do More: Towards Balancing the Gaps in Classification, Robustness, and Generation
summary: Joint Energy-based Models (JEMs) are well known for their ability to unify classification and generation within a single framework. Despite their promising generative and discriminative performance, their robustness remains far inferior to adversarial training (AT), which, conversely, achieves strong robustness but sacrifices clean accuracy and lacks generative ability. This inherent trilemma-balancing classification accuracy, robustness, and generative capability-raises a fundamental question: Can a single model achieve all three simultaneously? To answer this, we conduct a systematic energy landscape analysis of clean, adversarial, and generated samples across various JEM and AT variants. We observe that AT reduces the energy gap between clean and adversarial samples, while JEMs narrow the gap between clean and synthetic ones. This observation suggests a key insight: if the energy distributions of all three data types can be aligned, we might bridge their performance disparities. Building on this idea, we propose Energy-based Joint Distribution Adversarial Training (EB-JDAT), a unified generative-discriminative-robust framework that maximizes the joint probability of clean and adversarial distribution. EB-JDAT introduces a novel min-max energy optimization to explicitly aligning energies across clean, adversarial, and generated samples. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet subsets demonstrate that EB-JDAT achieves state-of-the-art robustness while maintaining near-original accuracy and competitive generation quality of JEMs, effectively achieving a new trade-off frontier between accuracy, robustness, and generation. The code is released at https://github.com/yujkc/EB-JDAT.

AI.title_translation: 你的分类器能做得更多：迈向平衡分类、鲁棒性与生成之间的鸿沟
AI.tldr: 提出EB-JDAT，通过最小-最大能量优化对齐干净/对抗/生成样本的能量分布，在保持接近原始准确率与具竞争力生成质量的同时，实现SOTA鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: JEM能统一分类与生成但鲁棒性弱；对抗训练(AT)鲁棒性强但牺牲干净准确率且缺乏生成能力。为解决“准确率-鲁棒性-生成能力”三难困境，探索单一模型能否同时兼顾三者。
AI.method: 1) 系统分析不同JEM与AT变体在干净、对抗、生成样本上的能量景观与能量间隙；2) 基于观察提出EB-JDAT（Energy-based Joint Distribution Adversarial Training），通过最大化干净与对抗分布的联合概率，采用新的min-max能量优化，显式对齐干净/对抗/生成三类样本的能量分布，从而统一生成-判别-鲁棒学习。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100及ImageNet子集上，EB-JDAT实现最先进的鲁棒性，同时保持接近原始的干净准确率，并达到与JEM相当且具竞争力的生成质量，形成新的三者权衡前沿。
AI.conclusion: 通过对齐干净、对抗与生成样本的能量分布，可在单一能量模型框架下同时提升分类准确率、对抗鲁棒性与生成能力；EB-JDAT有效缓解三难困境并刷新权衡边界。
AI.translation: 联合能量模型（JEM）以在单一框架中统一分类与生成为人所知。尽管它们在生成与判别性能上颇具潜力，其鲁棒性仍显著弱于对抗训练（AT）；而AT虽具强鲁棒性，却会牺牲干净样本准确率且不具生成能力。这种在分类准确率、鲁棒性与生成能力之间的三难权衡提出了一个根本问题：单一模型能否同时实现三者？为此，我们系统分析了多种JEM与AT变体在干净、对抗及生成样本上的能量景观。我们发现AT会缩小干净与对抗样本之间的能量差距，而JEM会缩小干净与合成样本之间的差距。这启示我们：若能对齐三类数据的能量分布，便可能弥合性能差异。基于此，我们提出能量式联合分布对抗训练（EB-JDAT），一种统一的生成-判别-鲁棒框架，通过最大化干净与对抗分布的联合概率学习。EB-JDAT引入新的最小-最大能量优化，以显式对齐干净、对抗与生成样本的能量。大量在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100与ImageNet子集上的实验表明，EB-JDAT在保持接近原始准确率与JEM具竞争力的生成质量的同时，实现了最先进的鲁棒性，从而在准确率、鲁棒性与生成之间获得新的权衡前沿。代码地址：https://github.com/yujkc/EB-JDAT。
AI.summary: 论文围绕能量模型在“分类-鲁棒-生成”三目标上的权衡展开：AT擅长鲁棒但损失准确率且不可生成，JEM兼顾分类与生成但鲁棒不足。作者通过能量景观分析发现两类方法分别缩小不同数据对（干净-对抗、干净-生成）的能量间隙，进而提出通过对齐三类样本能量分布来统一三者表现。所提EB-JDAT以最大化干净与对抗分布的联合概率为核心，并用min-max能量优化显式对齐干净/对抗/生成能量，实验在多个数据集上验证其在鲁棒性、干净准确率与生成质量之间取得更优综合折中。
AI.keywords: 联合能量模型(JEM), 对抗训练(AT), 能量景观分析, 能量分布对齐, 生成-判别统一, 对抗鲁棒性, EB-JDAT, min-max优化, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet子集
AI.comments: 优点：用能量分布对齐的视角统一解释AT与JEM的差异，并给出可操作的min-max能量优化框架；同时报告在多数据集上兼顾鲁棒性与生成/准确率的改进。局限：摘要未说明具体攻击设置、威胁模型、训练细节与生成质量评估指标；“SOTA鲁棒性”与“竞争力生成质量”的具体数值与对比方法未在摘要中给出。

title: RF4D:Neural Radar Fields for Novel View Synthesis in Outdoor Dynamic Scenes
summary: Neural fields (NFs) have achieved remarkable success in scene reconstruction and novel view synthesis. However, existing NF approaches that rely on RGB or LiDAR inputs often struggle under adverse weather conditions, limiting their robustness in real-world outdoor environments such as autonomous driving. In contrast, millimeter-wave radar is inherently resilient to environmental variations, yet its integration with NFs remains largely underexplored. Moreover, outdoor driving scenes frequently involve dynamic objects, making spatiotemporal modeling crucial for temporally consistent novel view synthesis. To address these challenges, we present RF4D, a radar-based neural field framework tailored for novel view synthesis in outdoor dynamic scenes. RF4D explicitly incorporates temporal information into its representation, enabling more accurate modeling of object motion. A dedicated scene flow module further predicts temporal offsets between adjacent frames, enforcing temporal occupancy coherence during dynamic scene reconstruction. Moreover, we propose a radar-specific power rendering formulation grounded in radar sensing physics, improving both synthesis accuracy and interpretability. Extensive experiments on public radar datasets demonstrate that RF4D substantially outperforms existing methods in radar measurement synthesis and occupancy estimation accuracy, with particularly strong gains in dynamic outdoor environments.

AI.title_translation: RF4D：用于室外动态场景新视角合成的神经雷达场
AI.tldr: 提出RF4D，一个面向室外动态场景的新视角合成雷达神经场框架：引入显式时间建模与场景流约束，并基于雷达物理提出功率渲染方式，在公开雷达数据集上显著提升雷达测量合成与占据估计，尤其在动态环境中表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有依赖RGB或LiDAR的神经场在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足；毫米波雷达更抗环境变化但与神经场结合研究不足；驾驶场景包含动态目标，需要时空建模以获得时间一致的新视角合成。
AI.method: RF4D雷达神经场框架：1）在表示中显式融入时间信息以建模运动；2）设计场景流(scene flow)模块预测相邻帧的时间偏移，并以此约束动态重建中的时间占据(occupancy)一致性；3）提出基于雷达感知物理的雷达特定功率(power)渲染公式，以提升合成精度与可解释性。
AI.result: 在公开雷达数据集上的大量实验表明，RF4D在雷达测量合成与占据估计精度上显著优于现有方法，并在动态室外环境中提升尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过时间显式建模、场景流驱动的时间一致性约束以及物理启发的雷达功率渲染，RF4D有效提升了室外动态场景中的雷达神经场重建与新视角合成性能与可解释性。
AI.translation: 译文（摘要中文翻译）：神经场在场景重建与新视角合成方面取得了显著成功。然而，现有依赖RGB或LiDAR输入的神经场方法在恶劣天气条件下常常表现不佳，限制了其在自动驾驶等真实室外环境中的鲁棒性。相比之下，毫米波雷达天然对环境变化更具韧性，但其与神经场的结合仍缺乏充分探索。此外，室外驾驶场景经常包含动态物体，使得时空建模对实现时间一致的新视角合成至关重要。为解决这些挑战，我们提出RF4D，一个面向室外动态场景新视角合成的雷达神经场框架。RF4D在其表示中显式引入时间信息，从而更准确地建模物体运动。一个专门的场景流模块进一步预测相邻帧之间的时间偏移，在动态场景重建过程中施加时间占据一致性约束。此外，我们提出一种基于雷达传感物理的雷达特定功率渲染形式，从而提升合成精度与可解释性。在公开雷达数据集上的大量实验表明，RF4D在雷达测量合成与占据估计精度上显著优于现有方法，且在动态室外环境中优势尤其明显。
AI.summary: 本文提出RF4D，将毫米波雷达引入神经场以应对室外恶劣天气与动态目标带来的挑战。方法上通过显式时间编码与场景流模块预测帧间时间偏移，约束占据的时间一致性；同时设计符合雷达物理的功率渲染以增强准确性与可解释性。实验在公开雷达数据集上验证其在雷达观测合成与占据估计方面全面优于现有方法，动态场景提升更显著。
AI.keywords: 神经场; 毫米波雷达; 新视角合成; 动态场景; 时空建模; 场景流; 占据估计; 功率渲染; 自动驾驶
AI.comments: 亮点：面向雷达的神经场建模，显式时间表示+场景流时间偏移约束提升动态一致性，物理驱动功率渲染增强可解释性。局限与细节：数据集名称、网络结构细节、损失函数、计算开销与实时性、与RGB/LiDAR融合策略等在摘要中未提及。

title: 3DGEER: 3D Gaussian Rendering Made Exact and Efficient for Generic Cameras
comments: Published at ICLR 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/boschresearch/3dgeer
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves an appealing balance between rendering quality and efficiency, but relies on approximating 3D Gaussians as 2D projections--an assumption that degrades accuracy, especially under generic large field-of-view (FoV) cameras. Despite recent extensions, no prior work has simultaneously achieved both projective exactness and real-time efficiency for general cameras. We introduce 3DGEER, a geometrically exact and efficient Gaussian rendering framework. From first principles, we derive a closed-form expression for integrating Gaussian density along a ray, enabling precise forward rendering and differentiable optimization under arbitrary camera models. To retain efficiency, we propose the Particle Bounding Frustum (PBF), which provides tight ray-Gaussian association without BVH traversal, and the Bipolar Equiangular Projection (BEAP), which unifies FoV representations, accelerates association, and improves reconstruction quality. Experiments on both pinhole and fisheye datasets show that 3DGEER outperforms prior methods across all metrics, runs 5x faster than existing projective exact ray-based baselines, and generalizes to wider FoVs unseen during training--establishing a new state of the art in real-time radiance field rendering.
comment: Published at ICLR 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/boschresearch/3dgeer

AI.title_translation: 3DGEER：面向通用相机的精确且高效的3D高斯渲染
AI.tldr: 提出3DGEER，通过沿光线积分3D高斯的闭式解实现投影几何精确的可微渲染，并用PBF与BEAP在通用大视场相机下保持实时效率与更高重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有3D Gaussian Splatting依赖将3D高斯近似为2D投影，导致在通用/大视场(FoV)相机下精度下降；同时此前方法未能在通用相机上同时兼顾投影精确性与实时效率。
AI.method: 1) 从第一性原理推导沿光线积分高斯密度的闭式表达式，用于精确前向渲染并支持在任意相机模型下的可微优化；2) 提出Particle Bounding Frustum (PBF) 在无需BVH遍历的情况下实现紧致的光线-高斯关联；3) 提出Bipolar Equiangular Projection (BEAP) 统一FoV表示以加速关联并提升重建质量。
AI.result: 在针孔与鱼眼数据集上的实验表明：3DGEER在所有指标上优于先前方法；相较现有“投影精确的基于光线”基线快约5倍；并能泛化到训练未见过的更宽FoV，达到实时辐射场渲染的新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 3DGEER通过闭式光线积分实现几何/投影精确的3D高斯渲染，同时借助PBF与BEAP保持高效与良好泛化，在通用相机特别是大FoV场景下实现更准确且实时的渲染与重建。
AI.translation: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.summary: 论文针对3DGS在大视场通用相机下因2D投影近似带来的误差，提出3DGEER：用闭式解精确计算光线穿过3D高斯的积分，实现任意相机模型下的精确可微渲染；并通过PBF避免BVH遍历、通过BEAP统一视场表示以加速光线-高斯匹配并提升重建。实验显示其在针孔/鱼眼数据上全面优于已有方法，速度较现有精确光线基线提升约5倍，并能泛化到更宽FoV，形成实时渲染新SOTA。

title: AceVFI: A Comprehensive Survey of Advances in Video Frame Interpolation
comments: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT). Please visit our project page at https://github.com/CMLab-Korea/Awesome-Video-Frame-Interpolation
summary: Video Frame Interpolation (VFI) is a core low-level vision task that synthesizes intermediate frames between existing ones while ensuring spatial and temporal coherence. Over the past decades, VFI methodologies have evolved from classical motion compensation-based approach to a wide spectrum of deep learning-based approaches, including kernel-, flow-, hybrid-, phase-, GAN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, and most recently, diffusion-based models. We introduce AceVFI, a comprehensive and up-to-date review of the VFI field, covering over 250 representative papers. We systematically categorize VFI methods based on their core design principles and architectural characteristics. Further, we classify them into two major learning paradigms: Center-Time Frame Interpolation (CTFI) and Arbitrary-Time Frame Interpolation (ATFI). We analyze key challenges in VFI, including large motion, occlusion, lighting variation, and non-linear motion. In addition, we review standard datasets, loss functions, evaluation metrics. We also explore VFI applications in other domains and highlight future research directions. This survey aims to serve as a valuable reference for researchers and practitioners seeking a thorough understanding of the modern VFI landscape.

AI.title_translation: AceVFI：视频帧插值进展的综合综述
AI.tldr: 本文提出AceVFI综述，系统回顾并分类250余篇视频帧插值（VFI）工作，按设计原则与架构特征归纳方法，并以中心时刻插值（CTFI）与任意时刻插值（ATFI）两大学习范式组织，同时总结挑战、数据集、损失、指标、应用与未来方向。
AI.motivation: VFI作为核心低层视觉任务，方法体系从传统运动补偿发展到多种深度学习范式，研究分支繁多且持续演进，需要一份全面、最新、系统化的综述为研究者与实践者提供参考与全景理解。
AI.method: 提出AceVFI综述：覆盖250余篇代表性论文；按核心设计原则与架构特征系统分类VFI方法（包括kernel、flow、hybrid、phase、GAN、Transformer、Mamba、diffusion等）；进一步按学习范式划分为CTFI与ATFI；分析关键挑战（大运动、遮挡、光照变化、非线性运动）；并回顾标准数据集、损失函数与评估指标，讨论跨领域应用与未来研究方向。
AI.result: 形成一个覆盖广泛且最新的VFI方法分类与组织框架（含CTFI/ATFI两范式），并对挑战、数据集、损失、指标、应用与未来方向给出系统梳理。具体定量结果或对比结论未在摘要中给出。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在成为研究者与从业者理解现代VFI研究版图的有价值参考资料，通过系统分类与问题/资源/方向梳理促进后续研究与应用落地。
AI.translation: 视频帧插值（VFI）是一项核心的低层视觉任务，其目标是在现有帧之间合成中间帧，同时保证空间与时间一致性。过去数十年间，VFI方法从经典的基于运动补偿的方案发展为广泛的深度学习方法谱系，包括基于核、光流、混合、相位、GAN、Transformer、Mamba以及最新的扩散模型。我们提出AceVFI，一份全面且最新的VFI综述，覆盖250余篇代表性论文。我们依据核心设计原则与架构特征对VFI方法进行系统分类，并进一步将其归纳为两种主要学习范式：中心时刻帧插值（CTFI）与任意时刻帧插值（ATFI）。我们分析了VFI中的关键挑战，包括大运动、遮挡、光照变化与非线性运动。此外，我们回顾了标准数据集、损失函数与评估指标，并探讨了VFI在其他领域的应用与未来研究方向。本综述旨在为希望全面理解现代VFI图景的研究人员与实践者提供有价值的参考。

title: On the Inversion Modulo a Power of an Integer
summary: Recently, Koç proposed a neat and efficient algorithm for computing \[ x = a^{-1} \pmod {p^k} \] for a prime $p$ based on the exact solution of linear equations using $p$-adic expansions. The algorithm requires only addition and right shift per step. In the first part of this paper, we design an algorithm that computes \[ x = a^{-1} \pmod {n^k} \] for any integers $a, n>1$ with $\gcd(a, n)=1$. The algorithm has a motivation from the schoolbook multiplication and achieves both efficiency and generality. The greater flexibility of our algorithm is explored by utilizing the built-in arithmetic of computer architecture, e.g., $n=2^{64}$, and experimental results show significant improvements. This paper also contains some results on modular inverse based on an alternative proof of correctness of Koç algorithm. For the computation of modular inverses when the modulus is a special power of a prime $p$ (i.e., of the form $p^{2^s}$), an efficient algorithm was developed by Dumas and later improved by Hurchalla. These methods are based on Hensel lifting and perform particularly well when $p=2$ and $2^s$ matches the native bit width of a computer. In the second part of the paper, we present a generalization of these methods to moduli of the form $n^{2^s}$ for any integer $n>1$. The derivation of our algorithm follows from a simple algebraic manipulation.

AI.title_translation: 关于整数幂模下的求逆
AI.tldr: 提出两类算法：将Koç针对素数幂模的求逆推广到一般模数n^k，并将基于Hensel提升的p^{2^s}求逆方法推广到n^{2^s}；利用计算机原生字宽（如n=2^{64}）获得实验上的显著加速。
AI.motivation: Koç给出对素数幂p^k的高效求逆算法（每步仅加法与右移），但缺乏对一般整数幂模n^k的通用性；同时希望利用计算机体系结构的内建算术（原生位宽）提升效率，并推广Dumas/Hurchalla对特殊幂次p^{2^s}的高效方法到更一般的n^{2^s}。
AI.method: 第一部分：设计计算x=a^{-1} mod n^k（a,n>1且gcd(a,n)=1）的算法，灵感来自“竖式/学校式乘法”，强调高效与通用；并结合对Koç算法正确性的另一种证明给出若干关于模逆的结果。第二部分：通过简单代数变形，将基于Hensel lifting的Dumas/Hurchalla方法从p^{2^s}推广到任意n^{2^s}的模数。
AI.result: 算法可处理任意n^k（在互素条件下）并具有更大灵活性；通过利用如n=2^{64}等原生字宽算术，实验结果显示性能显著提升；并给出基于Koç算法另一种正确性证明的相关模逆结果。
AI.conclusion: 提出的通用求逆算法在保持效率的同时扩展了适用模数范围（从素数幂到一般整数幂），且在与硬件字宽匹配的设置下可获得明显加速；同时将p^{2^s}情形的高效提升法自然推广到n^{2^s}。

title: Enhancing Sample Efficiency in Multi-Agent RL with Uncertainty Quantification and Selective Exploration
summary: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) methods have achieved state-of-the-art results on a range of multi-agent tasks. Yet, MARL algorithms typically require significantly more environment interactions than their single-agent counterparts to converge, a problem exacerbated by the difficulty in exploring over a large joint action space and the high variance intrinsic to MARL environments. To tackle these issues, we propose a novel algorithm that combines a decomposed centralized critic with decentralized ensemble learning, incorporating several key contributions. The main component in our scheme is a selective exploration method that leverages ensemble kurtosis. We extend the global decomposed critic with a diversity-regularized ensemble of individual critics and utilize its excess kurtosis to guide exploration toward high-uncertainty states and actions. To improve sample efficiency, we train the centralized critic with a novel truncated variation of the TD($λ$) algorithm, enabling efficient off-policy learning with reduced variance. On the actor side, our suggested algorithm adapts the mixed samples approach to MARL, mixing on-policy and off-policy loss functions for training the actors. This approach balances between stability and efficiency and outperforms purely off-policy learning. The evaluation shows our method outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on standard MARL benchmarks, including a variety of SMAC II maps.

AI.title_translation: 通过不确定性量化与选择性探索提升多智能体强化学习的样本效率
AI.tldr: 提出一种结合分解式集中式评论家、去中心化集成评论家与基于集成峰度的不确定性引导选择性探索的MARL算法，并通过截断TD(λ)与混合在/离策略演员训练提升样本效率，在SMAC II等基准上优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: MARL相比单智能体通常需要更多环境交互才能收敛，原因包括联合动作空间大导致探索困难，以及MARL环境固有的高方差，从而降低样本效率。
AI.method: 1) 构建分解式集中式critic，并扩展为带多样性正则的个体critic集成（去中心化集成学习）；2) 以集成输出的超额峰度（excess kurtosis）作为不确定性指标，进行选择性探索，引导探索到高不确定性的状态-动作；3) 用一种截断版本的TD(λ)训练集中式critic，以支持高效离策略学习并降低方差；4) 在actor侧将mixed samples方法适配到MARL，混合在策略与离策略损失来训练actors，在稳定性与效率间折中。
AI.result: 在标准MARL基准上（包含多种SMAC II地图）实验评估显示，该方法优于最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性量化（集成峰度）驱动的选择性探索、低方差的截断TD(λ)离策略critic学习以及混合在/离策略的actor训练，可显著提升MARL样本效率并在基准任务上取得更优表现。
AI.translation: 多智能体强化学习（MARL）在多种多智能体任务上取得了最先进的结果。然而，与单智能体方法相比，MARL算法通常需要更多的环境交互才能收敛，这一问题因在庞大的联合动作空间中探索困难以及MARL环境固有的高方差而更加严重。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种新算法，将分解式集中评论家与去中心化集成学习相结合，并包含多项关键贡献。我们的核心组件是一种利用集成峰度的选择性探索方法。我们在全局分解评论家的基础上，引入带多样性正则的个体评论家集成，并利用其超额峰度引导探索到高不确定性的状态与动作。为提升样本效率，我们使用一种新颖的截断TD(λ)变体训练集中评论家，从而在降低方差的同时实现高效离策略学习。在actor侧，我们将混合样本（mixed samples）方法适配到MARL，通过混合在策略与离策略损失来训练actors；该方法在稳定性与效率之间取得平衡，并优于纯离策略学习。实验评估表明，我们的方法在标准MARL基准（包括多种SMAC II地图）上优于最先进的基线。
AI.summary: 论文针对MARL样本效率低（交互需求大、探索难与高方差）的问题，提出一种“分解式集中critic + 去中心化集成critic + 峰度不确定性引导探索”的框架：用带多样性正则的critic集成计算超额峰度来定位高不确定性状态/动作并进行选择性探索；用截断TD(λ)进行更低方差的离策略critic训练；actor端采用混合在/离策略损失以兼顾稳定与效率。方法在SMAC II等标准基准上整体优于SOTA基线。
AI.keywords: 多智能体强化学习; 样本效率; 不确定性量化; 集成学习; 选择性探索; 超额峰度; 分解式集中评论家; 截断TD(λ); 离策略学习; 混合在/离策略训练; SMAC II

title: Can Theoretical Physics Research Benefit from Language Agents?
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly advancing across diverse domains, yet their application in theoretical physics remains inadequate. While current models show competence in mathematical reasoning and code generation, we identify critical gaps in physical intuition, constraint satisfaction, and reliable reasoning that cannot be addressed through prompting alone. Physics demands approximation judgment, symmetry exploitation, and physical grounding that require AI agents specifically trained on physics reasoning patterns and equipped with physics-aware verification tools. We argue that LLM would require such domain-specialized training and tooling to be useful in real-world for physics research. We envision physics-specialized AI agents that seamlessly handle multimodal data, propose physically consistent hypotheses, and autonomously verify theoretical results. Realizing this vision requires developing physics-specific training datasets, reward signals that capture physical reasoning quality, and verification frameworks encoding fundamental principles. We call for collaborative efforts between physics and AI communities to build the specialized infrastructure necessary for AI-driven scientific discovery.

title: Swiss Parliaments Corpus Re-Imagined (SPC_R): Enhanced Transcription with RAG-based Correction and Predicted BLEU
comments: Change: Updated number of hours for train/test
summary: This paper presents a new long-form release of the Swiss Parliaments Corpus, converting entire multi-hour Swiss German debate sessions (each aligned with the official session protocols) into high-quality speech-text pairs. Our pipeline starts by transcribing all session audio into Standard German using Whisper Large-v3 under high-compute settings. We then apply a two-step GPT-4o correction process: first, GPT-4o ingests the raw Whisper output alongside the official protocols to refine misrecognitions, mainly named entities. Second, a separate GPT-4o pass evaluates each refined segment for semantic completeness. We filter out any segments whose Predicted BLEU score (derived from Whisper's average token log-probability) and GPT-4o evaluation score fall below a certain threshold. The final corpus contains 801 hours of audio, of which 555 hours pass our quality control. Compared to the original sentence-level SPC release, our long-form dataset achieves a 6-point BLEU improvement, demonstrating the power of combining robust ASR, LLM-based correction, and data-driven filtering for low-resource, domain-specific speech corpora.
